<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let w, h, t = 0;

function resize() {
    w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
window.onresize = resize;
resize();

function draw() {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.2)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    
    // Physics constants
    const duration = 3000; // 30 seconds at 100fps
    const progress = Math.min(t / duration, 1);
    
    // Grid animation params
    const gridSize = 40;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2255ff';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;

    // Phase transitions
    const isMerger = progress > 0.85;
    const isRingdown = progress > 0.92;
    
    // Orbital mechanics (Chirp)
    const orbitRadius = (1 - Math.pow(progress, 0.5)) * 200;
    const frequency = Math.pow(1 - progress, -0.6) * 0.05;
    const angle = t * frequency;

    // Draw Grid
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x += gridSize) {
        for (let y = 0; y < h; y += gridSize) {
            let dx = x - w/2;
            let dy = y - h/2;
            let dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
            
            // Wave propagation
            let wave = Math.sin(dist * 0.05 - t * 0.2) * (1 - progress) * 2;
            if(isRingdown) wave *= Math.exp(-(progress - 0.92) * 50);

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x + wave, y);
            ctx.lineTo(x + wave + 5, y);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }

    // Draw Black Holes
    if (!isRingdown) {
        const x1 = w/2 + Math.cos(angle) * orbitRadius;
        const y1 = h/2 + Math.sin(angle) * orbitRadius;
        const x2 = w/2 + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI) * orbitRadius;
        const y2 = h/2 + Math.sin(angle + Math.PI) * orbitRadius;
        
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x1, y1, 5 * (1-progress*0.5), 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.arc(x2, y2, 5 * (1-progress*0.5), 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fill();
    } else {
        // Ringdown singularity
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(w/2, h/2, 10 * Math.exp(-(progress-0.92)*10), 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fill();
    }

    t++;
    if (t < duration) requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

draw();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Binary Black Hole Gravitational Waves</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;background:#05070c;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
function resize(){
  canvas.width = innerWidth;
  canvas.height = innerHeight;
}
addEventListener("resize",resize);
resize();

/* ---------- Physical-ish parameters (dimensionless units) ---------- */
const G = 1;
const M1 = 1;
const M2 = 1;
const M = M1 + M2;
const c = 10;               // scaled speed of light
const r0 = 6;               // initial separation
const mergeTime = 20;       // seconds
const totalTime = 30;
const rdFreq = 1.2;         // ringdown frequency
const rdTau = 3.5;          // damping time

/* sanity check limits */
const vmaxLimit = 0.6 * c;

/* world scale */
const scale = 90;

/* grid settings */
const gridExtent = 12;
const gridStep = 0.6;

/* compute inspiral separation (post-Newtonian inspired decay) */
function separation(t){
  if(t>=mergeTime) return 0;
  const u = 1 - t/mergeTime;
  return r0 * Math.pow(u,0.25);
}

/* orbital frequency from Kepler */
function omega(r){
  return Math.sqrt(G*M/(r*r*r));
}

/* phase integral approximation */
let phase=0, lastT=0;
function updatePhase(t){
  const dt = t-lastT;
  const r = separation(t);
  if(r>0){
    const w = omega(r);
    const v = w*r/2;
    if(v < vmaxLimit) phase += w*dt;
  }
  lastT = t;
}

/* quadrupole strain amplitude */
function strainAmp(r_sep, R){
  if(r_sep<=0) return 0;
  return 0.35*(M*r_sep*r_sep)/(R*c*c*c*c);
}

/* retarded orbital phase */
function phaseAt(t){
  if(t < mergeTime){
    const r = separation(t);
    const w = omega(r);
    return w*t*2;
  }else{
    const dt = t-mergeTime;
    return phase*2 + Math.sin(rdFreq*dt)*Math.exp(-dt/rdTau);
  }
}

/* draw warped grid */
function drawGrid(time){
  ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(140,170,255,0.55)";
  ctx.lineWidth=1;

  const cx = canvas.width/2;
  const cy = canvas.height/2;

  function warp(x,y){
    const R = Math.sqrt(x*x+y*y)+0.001;
    const travel = R/c;
    const tRet = time - travel;

    let h=0;

    if(tRet < mergeTime){
      const r = separation(Math.max(tRet,0));
      const ph = phaseAt(tRet);
      h = strainAmp(r,R)*Math.cos(ph);
    }else{
      const dt = tRet-mergeTime;
      h = 0.015*Math.exp(-dt/rdTau)*Math.cos(rdFreq*dt*2);
    }

    const dx = h*x;
    const dy = -h*y;

    return [
      cx + (x+dx)*scale,
      cy + (y+dy)*scale
    ];
  }

  for(let x=-gridExtent;x<=gridExtent;x+=gridStep){
    ctx.beginPath();
    let first=true;
    for(let y=-gridExtent;y<=gridExtent;y+=0.15){
      const p=warp(x,y);
      if(first){ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);first=false;}
      else ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  for(let y=-gridExtent;y<=gridExtent;y+=gridStep){
    ctx.beginPath();
    let first=true;
    for(let x=-gridExtent;x<=gridExtent;x+=0.15){
      const p=warp(x,y);
      if(first){ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);first=false;}
      else ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

/* draw black holes */
function drawBH(t){
  const cx = canvas.width/2;
  const cy = canvas.height/2;

  if(t < mergeTime){
    const r = separation(t)/2;
    const ang = phase;

    const x1 = cx + Math.cos(ang)*r*scale;
    const y1 = cy + Math.sin(ang)*r*scale;

    const x2 = cx - Math.cos(ang)*r*scale;
    const y2 = cy - Math.sin(ang)*r*scale;

    ctx.fillStyle="black";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x1,y1,10,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x2,y2,10,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }else{
    ctx.fillStyle="black";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx,cy,14,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

/* animation */
let start=null;
function frame(ts){
  if(!start) start=ts;
  const t=(ts-start)/1000;

  ctx.fillStyle="#05070c";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);

  updatePhase(t);
  drawGrid(t);
  drawBH(t);

  if(t < totalTime) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Gravitational‑Wave Grid Animation (30 s)</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0a0a;}
  canvas{display:block;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>

<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1️⃣  Canvas & resize handling
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  function resize() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2️⃣  Physical constants (in convenient “visual” units)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  const G = 1;                // gravitational constant (scaled)
  const c = 1;                // speed of light (scaled)
  const M1 = 30;              // mass of BH1 (solar‑mass units, arbitrary)
  const M2 = 30;              // mass of BH2
  const Mtot = M1 + M2;       // total mass
  const a0 = 200;             // initial orbital separation (pixels)
  const tMerge = 20;          // time of merger (seconds)
  const totalTime = 30;       // total animation length (seconds)

  // Ring‑down parameters (chosen for visual effect)
  const fRing = 0.8;          // ring‑down frequency (Hz)
  const tau = 3;              // damping time (seconds)
  const A0 = 12;              // initial amplitude (pixels)

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3️⃣  Grid definition
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  const gridStep = 20;        // distance between grid points (px)
  const halfStep = gridStep / 2;

  // Pre‑compute a static array of grid points for speed
  const points = [];
  for (let y = 0; y <= canvas.height; y += gridStep) {
    for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += gridStep) {
      points.push({x, y});
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4️⃣  Helper functions
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  // Returns orbital separation a(t) for t < tMerge
  function separation(t) {
    const frac = Math.max(0, 1 - t / tMerge);
    return a0 * Math.pow(frac, 0.25); // a ∝ (t_merge - t)^{1/4}
  }

  // Returns angular frequency ω(t) from Kepler’s law
  function omega(t) {
    const a = separation(t);
    return Math.sqrt(G * Mtot / Math.pow(a, 3));
  }

  // Returns the orbital phase θ(t) = ∫ ω dt  (numerical integration)
  const phaseCache = new Map();
  function phase(t) {
    if (phaseCache.has(t)) return phaseCache.get(t);
    // Simple trapezoidal integration with small step
    const dt = 0.01;
    let sum = 0;
    for (let ti = 0; ti < t; ti += dt) {
      sum += omega(ti) * dt;
    }
    phaseCache.set(t, sum);
    return sum;
  }

  // Position of the two BHs (if still separate)
  function bhPositions(t) {
    if (t >= tMerge) return null; // merged
    const a = separation(t);
    const th = phase(t);
    const cx = canvas.width / 2;
    const cy = canvas.height / 2;
    const x1 = cx + (a / 2) * Math.cos(th);
    const y1 = cy + (a / 2) * Math.sin(th);
    const x2 = cx - (a / 2) * Math.cos(th);
    const y2 = cy - (a / 2) * Math.sin(th);
    return [{x: x1, y: y1}, {x: x2, y: y2}];
  }

  // Wave contribution from a source at (sx,sy) with frequency f and amplitude amp
  function waveContribution(px, py, sx, sy, f, amp, t) {
    const dx = px - sx;
    const dy = py - sy;
    const r = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 0.1; // avoid division by zero
    const travelTime = r / c;
    const phase = 2 * Math.PI * f * (t - travelTime);
    // Amplitude falls as 1/r (spherical wave) and is limited to a few pixels
    return (amp / r) * Math.sin(phase);
  }

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5️⃣  Main animation loop
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------
  const start = performance.now();

  function draw() {
    const now = performance.now();
    const t = (now - start) / 1000; // seconds

    // Stop after totalTime
    if (t > totalTime) return;

    // Clear
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Draw soft grid (light gray)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let y = 0; y <= canvas.height; y += gridStep) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let x = 0; x <= canvas.width; x += gridStep) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6️⃣  Compute wave field and displace grid points
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    const bhs = bhPositions(t);
    const pointsToDraw = [];

    for (const p of points) {
      let disp = 0;

      if (bhs) {
        // Inspiral: two sources with instantaneous orbital frequency
        const fOrb = omega(t) / (2 * Math.PI); // convert rad/s → Hz
        const amp = 8; // visual amplitude scaling
        for (const bh of bhs) {
          disp += waveContribution(p.x, p.y, bh.x, bh.y, fOrb, amp, t);
        }
      } else {
        // Ring‑down: single source at centre
        const cx = canvas.width / 2;
        const cy = canvas.height / 2;
        const amp = A0 * Math.exp(-(t - tMerge) / tau);
        disp += waveContribution(p.x, p.y, cx, cy, fRing, amp, t);
      }

      // Displace point radially from the nearest source (or centre)
      let nx = p.x, ny = p.y;
      if (bhs) {
        // Choose the nearer BH for direction (good enough for visual)
        const d1 = Math.hypot(p.x - bhs[0].x, p.y - bhs[0].y);
        const d2 = Math.hypot(p.x - bhs[1].x, p.y - bhs[1].y);
        const src = d1 < d2 ? bhs[0] : bhs[1];
        const dx = p.x - src.x, dy = p.y - src.y;
        const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 0.1;
        nx += (dx / len) * disp;
        ny += (dy / len) * disp;
      } else {
        const cx = canvas.width / 2, cy = canvas.height / 2;
        const dx = p.x - cx, dy = p.y - cy;
        const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) + 0.1;
        nx += (dx / len) * disp;
        ny += (dy / len) * disp;
      }

      pointsToDraw.push({x: nx, y: ny});
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 7️⃣  Render displaced points as small circles (soft look)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
    for (const pt of pointsToDraw) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, 2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // 8️⃣  Draw the black holes (filled dark circles)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    if (bhs) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      for (const bh of bhs) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(bh.x, bh.y, 12, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    } else {
      // Post‑merger remnant (small dark circle)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2, 10, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Next frame
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  // Kick‑off
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Gravitational Wave Inspiral & Ringdown</title>
<style>
  body {margin:0;background:#000;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;}
  canvas{background:#111;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
/* ---------- Configuration ---------- */
const duration   = 30;          // total animation time (seconds)
const t_merge    = 15;          // end of inspiral / start of ringdown
const tau        = 2;           // ringdown damping time (seconds)
const omega_rd   = 12;          // ringdown angular frequency (rad/s) ≈ 1.9 Hz GW
const Mtotal     = 2.0;         // total mass (G=c=1, equal masses → each =1)
const mu         = 0.5;         // reduced mass m1*m2/Mtotal
const A0         = 0.2 * 5.3;   // inspiral amplitude scaling (will be normalized)
const Amax       = 0.8;         // maximum inspiral amplitude (clipped)
const eps        = 1e-3;        // small number to avoid div‑by‑zero
const scale      = 20;          // pixels per length unit
const canvasSize = 800;
/* ----------------------------------- */

const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx    = canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width = canvas.height = canvasSize;
const cx = canvasSize/2;
const cy = canvasSize/2;

let startTime = performance.now();
let lastTime  = startTime;
let t = 0;                     // elapsed simulation time (seconds)
let r = 0;                     // orbital separation
let theta = 0;                 // orbital phase
let gwPhase = 0;               // gravitational wave phase (2*theta)
const wavefronts = [];         // each = {te, A, omegaEmit}

/* ---- Inspiral radius evolution (radiation reaction) ---- */
function radiusAtTime(time){
  if (time >= t_merge) return 0;
  const r4 = Math.pow(5.3,4) - (256/5)*time;   // 5.3 chosen so r→0 at t_merge
  return Math.pow(Math.max(0, r4), 0.25);
}

/* ---- Amplitude at a given emission time ---- */
function amplitudeAtTime(time){
  if (time < t_merge){
    const r_t = radiusAtTime(time);
    let A = A0 / Math.max(r_t, eps);
    if (A > Amax) A = Amax;
    return A;
  }else{
    const tr = time - t_merge;
    const base = Amax * Math.exp(-tr/tau);
    const osc  = 1 + 0.5 * Math.sin(omega_rd * tr); // ringdown oscillation
    return base * osc;
  }
}

/* ---- Orbital angular frequency (Kepler, with a safety cap) ---- */
function orbitalOmega(sep){
  if (sep <= eps) return 20; // cap to avoid blow‑up
  const om = Math.sqrt(Mtotal / Math.pow(sep,3));
  return Math.min(om, 20);   // safety cap
}

/* ---- Emit a new wavefront whenever GW phase advances by 2π ---- */
function maybeEmit(){
  while (gwPhase >= 2*Math.PI){
    const Aemit = amplitudeAtTime(t);
    const omegaEmit = (t < t_merge) ? orbitalOmega(r) : omega_rd;
    wavefronts.push({te: t, A: Aemit, omegaEmit: omegaEmit});
    gwPhase -= 2*Math.PI;
  }
}

/* ---- Main animation loop ---- */
function draw(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const elapsed = (now - startTime)/1000.0; // seconds

  if (elapsed >= duration){
    // show final frame then stop
    t = duration;
    r = radiusAtTime(t);
    theta = 0; // not used after merger
    gwPhase = 0;
    wavefronts.length = 0;
    maybeEmit();
    render();
    return;
  }

  const dt = (now - lastTime)/1000.0;
  lastTime = now;

  t += dt;
  if (t < t_merge){
    r = radiusAtTime(t);
    const om = orbitalOmega(r);
    theta += om * dt;
    gwPhase += 2 * om * dt;
  }else{
    // post‑merger: keep r=0, theta irrelevant
    gwPhase += 2 * omega_rd * dt;
  }

  maybeEmit();

  // discard wavefronts that have left the view
  const maxRadiusUnits = (canvasSize/2)/scale + 5;
  for(let i=wavefronts.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const w = wavefronts[i];
    const age = t - w.te;
    if (age > maxRadiusUnits) wavefronts.splice(i,1);
  }

  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

function render(){
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvasSize,canvasSize);

  /* ----- faint grid ----- */
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,80,80,0.2)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const gridStep = 40; // pixels
  for(let x=0;x<=canvasSize;x+=gridStep){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x,0); ctx.lineTo(x,canvasSize); ctx.stroke();
  }
  for(let y=0;y<=canvasSize;y+=gridStep){
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(canvasSize,y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  /* ----- wavefronts ----- */
  for(const w of wavefronts){
    const age = t - w.te;
    if (age <= 0) continue;
    const radiusPx = age * scale;
    const A = w.A;
    // geometric 1/R fall‑off
    const spread = 1.0/(age + eps);
    // oscillation due to GW phase since emission
    const phaseSince = age * w.omegaEmit * 2.0; // GW phase advance
    const osc = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(phaseSince); // 0 … 1
    const alpha = A * spread * osc * 0.4; // tweak for visibility
    if (alpha <= 0) continue;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, radiusPx, 0, 2*Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  /* ----- black holes ----- */
  if (t < t_merge){
    const offset = (r/2) * scale;
    const x1 = cx + offset * Math.cos(theta);
    const y1 = cy + offset * Math.sin(theta);
    const x2 = cx - offset * Math.cos(theta);
    const y2 = cy - offset * Math.sin(theta);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x1,y1,6,0,2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x2,y2,6,0,2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
  }else{
    /* merged black hole – slightly larger */
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,12,0,2*Math.PI); ctx.fill();
  }
}

/* start animation */
requestAnimationFrame(draw);
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Gravitational Waves — Binary Black Hole Merger</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body { background: #000; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
'use strict';

const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W, H;

function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = innerHeight;
}
resize();
addEventListener('resize', resize);

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PHYSICAL CONSTANTS & SYSTEM PARAMETERS
   Binary: 60 + 60 M☉ at 410 Mpc (LIGO-like event GW150914)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const M_total = 60;                         // Total mass (solar masses)
const M_chirp = M_total * Math.pow(0.25, 0.6);  // Chirp mass ≈ 28.3 M☉
const D_dist = 410;                         // Luminosity distance (Mpc)
const f_isco = 1 / (6 * Math.sqrt(6) * Math.PI); // ISCO GW freq (1/M☉) ≈ 0.022

// Time mapping: compress real physics into 30 s animation
const T_INSPIRAL = 20;   // Chirp phase
const T_MERGER   = 1;    // Coalescence
const T_RINGDOWN = 9;    // Quasi-normal mode ringdown
const T_TOTAL    = 30;

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SIMULATION STATE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let simTime = 0;
let sep = 30;            // Orbital separation (M)
let omega = 0;           // Orbital angular velocity (1/M)
let phi = 0;             // Orbital phase (radians)
let mergerTime = 0;      // Time of coalescence
let initialized = false;
const history = [];      // Orbital trail

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BINARY EVOLUTION — Post-Newtonian Inspiral + Merger + QNM Ringdown
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function evolve(t) {
  if (t <= T_INSPIRAL) {
    // Peters formula: da/dt ∝ a⁻³  →  a(t) = a₀(1 − t/t_ins)^(1/4)
    const tau = Math.max(0, 1 - t / T_INSPIRAL);
    sep = 30 * Math.pow(tau, 0.25);
    sep = Math.max(sep, 6 * Math.sqrt(6));  // Enforce ISCO floor
    // Kepler's law: ω = M^½ / a^(3/2)
    omega = Math.sqrt(M_total) / Math.pow(sep, 1.5);
    phi += omega * 0.016;   // ~60 fps timestep
  } else if (t <= T_INSPIRAL + T_MERGER) {
    // Smooth plunge from ISCO to merger
    const mt = T_INSPIRAL;
    const p = (t - mt) / T_MERGER;
    const s0 = 6 * Math.sqrt(6);
    sep = s0 * (1 - p * p);
    omega = Math.sqrt(M_total) / Math.pow(Math.max(sep, 0.5), 1.5) * (1 + 2 * p);
    phi += omega * 0.016;
    if (!initialized) { mergerTime = t; initialized = true; }
  } else {
    // Ringdown: separation = 0, orbit locked
    sep = 0;
    omega = f_isco * 2 * Math.PI;
    phi += omega * 0.016;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GRAVITATIONAL WAVE STRAIN TENSOR at observer grid point
   Returns [h₊, h×] with full quadrupolar angular dependence
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function strainAt(x, y, t) {
  const dx = x - W / 2, dy = y - H / 2;
  const r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 1;
  const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);

  // Retarded time (wave travel from source to grid point)
  const tRet = t - r * 0.00008;

  let hp, hc;

  if (tRet > mergerTime && mergerTime > 0) {
    // ─── RINGDOWN: Damped quasi-normal mode ───
    const dt = tRet - mergerTime;
    const M_final = M_total * 0.95;
    // QNM frequency: f ≈ 0.373 √(M/2)⁻¹  (non-spinning Schwarzschild)
    const f_qnm = 0.373 / (Math.PI * M_final * 2);
    const tau_qnm = 2 * M_final;    // Damping time ≈ 2M
    const amp0 = 7.5e-21;           // Match merger peak strain
    const decay = Math.exp(-dt / tau_qnm);
    const qnmPhase = phi + f_qnm * 2 * Math.PI * dt;

    hp = amp0 * decay * Math.cos(qnmPhase) * Math.cos(2 * angle);
    hc = amp0 * decay * Math.sin(qnmPhase) * Math.cos(2 * angle);
  } else {
    // ─── INSPIRAL + MERGER: Quadrupole formula ───
    const f_gw = omega / Math.PI;   // GW frequency = 2 × orbital freq
    // h = (4/r) (M_chirp)^(5/3) (π f_gw)^(2/3)   [geometric units]
    const amp = (4 / r) * Math.pow(M_chirp, 5 / 3) *
                Math.pow(Math.PI * Math.abs(f_gw) + 0.01, 2 / 3);
    hp = amp * Math.cos(2 * phi) * Math.cos(2 * angle);
    hc = amp * Math.sin(2 * phi) * Math.cos(2 * angle);
  }
  return [hp, hc];
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RENDERING
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const GRID_SPACING = 38;
const STRAIN_SCALE = 1.5e22;   // Amplify sub-atomic strains for visualization

function drawStrainField() {
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const cols = Math.ceil(W / GRID_SPACING) + 4;
  const rows = Math.ceil(H / GRID_SPACING) + 4;
  const ox = cx - (cols >> 1) * GRID_SPACING;
  const oy = cy - (rows >> 1) * GRID_SPACING;

  // Draw deformed grid lines
  for (let i = 0; i <= rows; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    let first = true;
    for (let j = 0; j <= cols; j++) {
      const bx = ox + j * GRID_SPACING;
      const by = oy + i * GRID_SPACING;
      const [hp, hc] = strainAt(bx, by, simTime);

      // Apply strain tensor: δxᵢ = hᵢⱼ xⱼ
      const px = bx + STRAIN_SCALE * hp;
      const py = by - STRAIN_SCALE * hc;

      if (first) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); first = false; }
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    // Color by local strain magnitude
    const mx = ox + (cols >> 1) * GRID_SPACING;
    const my = oy + i * GRID_SPACING;
    const [hp0, hc0] = strainAt(mx, my, simTime);
    const mag = Math.sqrt(hp0 * hp0 + hc0 * hc0);
    const n = Math.min(1, mag * STRAIN_SCALE / 60);

    let r, g, b;
    if (n < 0.25)      { const s=n/0.25;           r=15;        g=15+s*50;  b=55+s*150; }
    else if (n < 0.5)  { const s=(n-0.25)/0.25;    r=15;        g=65+s*140; b=205-s*55; }
    else if (n < 0.75) { const s=(n-0.5)/0.25;     r=s*180;     g=205;      b=150-s*130; }
    else               { const s=(n-0.75)/0.25;     r=180+s*75;  g=205-s*130;b=20;        }

    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${r|0},${g|0},${b|0},0.3)`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  for (let j = 0; j <= cols; j++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    let first = true;
    for (let i = 0; i <= rows; i++) {
      const bx = ox + j * GRID_SPACING;
      const by = oy + i * GRID_SPACING;
      const [hp, hc] = strainAt(bx, by, simTime);
      const px = bx + STRAIN_SCALE * hp;
      const py = by - STRAIN_SCALE * hc;
      if (first) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); first = false; }
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    const mx = ox + j * GRID_SPACING;
    const my = oy + (rows >> 1) * GRID_SPACING;
    const [hp0, hc0] = strainAt(mx, my, simTime);
    const mag = Math.sqrt(hp0 * hp0 + hc0 * hc0);
    const n = Math.min(1, mag * STRAIN_SCALE / 60);

    let r, g, b;
    if (n < 0.25)      { const s=n/0.25;           r=15;        g=15+s*50;  b=55+s*150; }
    else if (n < 0.5)  { const s=(n-0.25)/0.25;    r=15;        g=65+s*140; b=205-s*55; }
    else if (n < 0.75) { const s=(n-0.5)/0.25;     r=s*180;     g=205;      b=150-s*130; }
    else               { const s=(n-0.75)/0.25;     r=180+s*75;  g=205-s*130;b=20;        }

    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${r|0},${g|0},${b|0},0.3)`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

function drawBlackHoles() {
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const r_orb = sep / 2;

  // Two BH positions (equal mass → symmetric about center)
  const x1 = cx + r_orb * Math.cos(phi);
  const y1 = cy + r_orb * Math.sin(phi);
  const x2 = cx - r_orb * Math.cos(phi);
  const y2 = cy - r_orb * Math.sin(phi);

  const rSch = sep > 1 ? 3.5 : 5;  // Visual Schwarzschild radius

  // Draw each black hole
  for (const [bx, by] of [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]]) {
    if (sep < 0.5) continue;  // Don't draw merged BHs at old positions

    // Accretion disk glow
    const g1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, rSch, bx, by, rSch * 8);
    g1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(100,160,255,0.12)');
    g1.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(50,100,200,0.03)');
    g1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bx, by, rSch * 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Photon ring (bright ring at event horizon)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bx, by, rSch * 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,200,255,0.35)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Event horizon (pure black shadow)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(bx, by, rSch, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Remnant black hole during ringdown
  if (sep <= 0.5 && mergerTime > 0) {
    const rr = 5.5;

    // Pulsing gravitational glow (oscillates at QNM frequency)
    const dt = simTime - mergerTime;
    const M_final = M_total * 0.95;
    const f_qnm = 0.373 / (Math.PI * M_final * 2);
    const pulse = Math.exp(-dt / (2 * M_final)) *
                  (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.cos(f_qnm * 2 * Math.PI * dt));

    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, rr, cx, cy, rr * 12);
    g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(100,180,255,${0.1 + pulse * 0.15})`);
    g.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(50,100,200,${pulse * 0.06})`);
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, rr * 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Photon ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, rr * 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(180,220,255,0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Event horizon
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, rr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawTrail() {
  if (history.length < 2) return;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + history[0][0], H / 2 + history[0][1]);
  for (let i = 1; i < history.length; i++) {
    ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + history[i][0], H / 2 + history[i][1]);
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,140,220,0.2)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.stroke();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MAIN ANIMATION LOOP
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let lastTime = 0;

function frame(timestamp) {
  const dt = lastTime ? Math.min((timestamp - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05) : 0.016;
  lastTime = timestamp;
  simTime = Math.min(simTime + dt, T_TOTAL - 0.01);

  // Evolve binary physics
  evolve(simTime);

  // Record orbital trail
  if (sep > 0.5) {
    history.push([sep / 2 * Math.cos(phi), sep / 2 * Math.sin(phi)]);
    if (history.length > 300) history.shift();
  }

  // ─── Clear canvas ───
  ctx.fillStyle = '#060610';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Subtle center glow
  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 0, W/2, H/2, Math.min(W,H)*0.4);
  bg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(12,16,35,0.4)');
  bg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // ─── Draw scene layers ───
  drawStrainField();
  drawTrail();
  drawBlackHoles();

  // Merger flash
  if (mergerTime > 0 && Math.abs(simTime - mergerTime) < 1) {
    const fd = simTime - mergerTime;
    const fi = Math.exp(-fd * fd * 8);
    const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 0, W/2, H/2, 200);
    fg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(180,210,255,${fi * 0.2})`);
    fg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = fg;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W/2, H/2, 200, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // ─── HUD: Phase label ───
  let phase, phaseTime;
  if (simTime < T_INSPIRAL) {
    phase = 'I N S P I R A L';  phaseTime = '0 – 20 s';
  } else if (simTime < T_INSPIRAL + T_MERGER) {
    phase = 'M E R G E R';      phaseTime = '20 – 21 s';
  } else {
    phase = 'R I N G D O W N';  phaseTime = '21 – 30 s';
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(180,200,230,0.7)';
  ctx.font = '13px "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(phase, W / 2, 28);
  ctx.font = '10px "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(130,150,180,0.45)';
  ctx.fillText(phaseTime, W / 2, 44);

  // HUD: Time
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,180,210,0.55)';
  ctx.font = '12px "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace';
  ctx.fillText(`t = ${simTime.toFixed(1)} s`, 16, 28);

  // HUD: Strain magnitude
  const [hp, hc] = strainAt(W / 2, H / 2 + 150, simTime);
  const mag = Math.sqrt(hp * hp + hc * hc);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,180,210,0.55)';
  ctx.fillText(`|h| ≈ ${mag.toExponential(1)}`, W - 16, 28);

  // HUD: Color bar legend
  const bw = 150, bh = 5, bx = W - bw - 16, by = H - 28;
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, 0, bx + bw, 0);
  grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgb(15,15,55)');
  grad.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgb(15,65,205)');
  grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgb(15,205,150)');
  grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgb(180,205,20)');
  grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgb(255,75,20)');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(130,150,180,0.35)';
  ctx.font = '9px "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('strain', bx + bw, by - 3);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('0', bx - 12, by + 4.5);

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

    // Set up the canvas
    const canvas = document.getElementById('myCanvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    canvas.width = 800;
    canvas.height = 800;

    // Constants
    const G = 6.67430e-11; // Gravitational constant
    const c = 3e8; // Speed of light
    const M = 1e36; // Mass of each black hole (kg)
    const R = 1e6; // Initial separation of black holes (m)
    const T = 30; // Total animation time (s)
    const FPS = 60; // Frames per second

    // Derived constants
    const m = M / 2; // Mass of each black hole
    const r = R / 2; // Initial position of each black hole
    const omega = Math.sqrt(G * (2 * M) / (R * R * R)); // Angular frequency
    const period = 2 * Math.PI / omega; // Period of orbit
    const t_merge = period / 4; // Time of merger
    const t_ringdown = T - 5; // Start of ringdown phase

    // Animation variables
    let t = 0; // Current time
    let x1, y1, x2, y2; // Positions of black holes
    let dx1, dy1, dx2, dy2; // Velocities of black holes
    let scale = canvas.width / (2 * R); // Scale factor for visualization

    // Animation loop
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      t += 1 / FPS;

      // Update black hole positions and velocities
      if (t < t_merge) {
        // Inspiral phase
        x1 = r * Math.cos(omega * t);
        y1 = r * Math.sin(omega * t);
        x2 = -r * Math.cos(omega * t);
        y2 = -r * Math.sin(omega * t);
        dx1 = -r * omega * Math.sin(omega * t);
        dy1 = r * omega * Math.cos(omega * t);
        dx2 = r * omega * Math.sin(omega * t);
        dy2 = -r * omega * Math.cos(omega * t);
      } else if (t < t_ringdown) {
        // Merger phase
        const t_rel = t - t_merge;
        const a = 0.7 * R / (t_merge * c);
        x1 = a * t_rel * Math.cos(omega * t_merge);
        y1 = a * t_rel * Math.sin(omega * t_merge);
        x2 = -a * t_rel * Math.cos(omega * t_merge);
        y2 = -a * t_rel * Math.sin(omega * t_merge);
        dx1 = -a * Math.cos(omega * t_merge);
        dy1 = a * Math.sin(omega * t_merge);
        dx2 = a * Math.cos(omega * t_merge);
        dy2 = -a * Math.sin(omega * t_merge);
      } else {
        // Ringdown phase
        const t_rel = t - t_ringdown;
        const a = 0.1 * R / (T - t_ringdown);
        x1 = a * t_rel * Math.cos(omega * t_ringdown);
        y1 = a * t_rel * Math.sin(omega * t_ringdown);
        x2 = -a * t_rel * Math.cos(omega * t_ringdown);
        y2 = -a * t_rel * Math.sin(omega * t_ringdown);
        dx1 = -a * Math.cos(omega * t_ringdown);
        dy1 = a * Math.sin(omega * t_ringdown);
        dx2 = a * Math.cos(omega * t_ringdown);
        dy2 = -a * Math.sin(omega * t_ringdown);
      }

      // Clear the canvas
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // Draw the grid
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let i = 0; i <= canvas.width; i += 50) {
        ctx.moveTo(i, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(i, canvas.height);
        ctx.moveTo(0, i);
        ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, i);
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      // Draw the black holes
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.arc(canvas.width / 2 + x1 * scale, canvas.height / 2 + y1 * scale, 10, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.arc(canvas.width / 2 + x2 * scale, canvas.height / 2 + y2 * scale, 10, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();

      // Check if the animation is complete
      if (t >= T) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animate);
      }
    }

    // Start the animation
    animate();
  </script>

        const gridColumns = Math.ceil(canvas.width / gridSize) + 1;
        const gridRows = Math.ceil(canvas.height / gridSize) + 1;

                };
            }
        }

        // Black hole parameters
        const M = 1; // Total mass (normalized)
        const q = 0.8; // Mass ratio m2/m1 (0.8 means slightly unequal masses)
        const m1 = M / (1 + q); // Mass of first black hole
        const m2 = M * q / (1 + q); // Mass of second black hole

        // Animation timing
        const fps = 60;
        const totalFrames = duration * fps;
        let currentFrame = 0;
        let mergeFrame = Math.floor(totalFrames * 0.6); // Merge at 60% of animation
        let ringdownStartFrame = mergeFrame + 5;

        // Initial orbital parameters
        const initialSeparation = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.25; // Responsive
        const G = 1; // Normalized gravitational constant
        const initialOmega = Math.sqrt(G * (m1 + m2) / Math.pow(initialSeparation, 3));

        // Black hole positions
        let bh1 = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        let bh2 = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        let mergedBH = { x: centerX, y: centerY };

        // Merged black hole parameters
        const finalSpin = 0.7; // Final dimensionless spin parameter (between 0 and 1)
        // Ringdown frequency depends on final black hole mass and spin
        const ringdownFreqFactor = 1.5 * (1 - 0.63 * Math.pow(1 - finalSpin, 0.3));

        // Gravitational wave parameters
        let waves = [];
        const waveSpeed = Math.max(4, gridSize * 0.15); // Responsive wave speed
        const maxWaveAmplitude = gridSize * 0.3; // Responsive wave amplitude

        // Star field for background
        const stars = [];
        const numStars = Math.floor(canvas.width * canvas.height / 5000);
        for (let i = 0; i < numStars; i++) {
            stars.push({
                x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
                y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
                radius: Math.random() * 1.5,
                brightness: Math.random()
            });
        }

        // Function to update black hole positions based on physical model
        function updateBlackHoles() {
            if (currentFrame < mergeFrame) {
                // Pre-merger: inspiral phase
                // Time to merger (normalized)
                const tau = (mergeFrame - currentFrame) / mergeFrame;
                
                // In GR, separation decreases as time^(1/4) before merger
                const separation = initialSeparation * Math.pow(tau, 0.25);
                
                // Orbital frequency increases as separation^(-3/2) per Kepler's law
                const omega = initialOmega * Math.pow(separation / initialSeparation, -1.5);
                
                // Accumulated orbital phase (integrate frequency)
                // Using approximation of the integrated phase
                const phase = initialOmega * Math.pow(tau, -0.25) * 4;
                
                // Calculate positions relative to center of mass
                const r1 = separation * m2 / (m1 + m2);
                const r2 = separation * m1 / (m1 + m2);
                
                bh1.x = centerX + r1 * Math.cos(phase);
                bh1.y = centerY + r1 * Math.sin(phase);
                
                bh2.x = centerX - r2 * Math.cos(phase);
                bh2.y = centerY - r2 * Math.sin(phase);
                
                // Generate gravitational waves during inspiral
                // Emit more frequent waves as merger approaches
                const waveInterval = Math.max(1, Math.floor(10 * tau));
                if (currentFrame % waveInterval === 0) {
                    const waveStrength = maxWaveAmplitude * (0.3 + 0.7 * (1 - tau));
                    waves.push({
                        x: centerX,
                        y: centerY,
                        radius: 0,
                        strength: waveStrength,
                        frequency: omega,
                        phase: phase,
                        time: currentFrame
                    });
                }
            } else {
                // Post-merger: single black hole at center
                bh1.x = bh2.x = mergedBH.x = centerX;
                bh1.y = bh2.y = mergedBH.y = centerY;
                
                // Ringdown phase - black hole emits decaying gravitational waves
                const ringdownDuration = 60; // frames
                if (currentFrame < ringdownStartFrame + ringdownDuration) {
                    // Generate ringdown waves with exponentially decaying amplitude
                    const timeSinceRingdown = (currentFrame - ringdownStartFrame) / fps;
                    // Decay time depends on final black hole parameters
                    const decayTime = 0.1 * (1 + finalSpin); // Longer for higher spin
                    const decayFactor = Math.exp(-timeSinceRingdown / decayTime);
                    
                    if (currentFrame % 2 === 0 && currentFrame < ringdownStartFrame + ringdownDuration/2) {
                        waves.push({
                            x: centerX,
                            y: centerY,
                            radius: 0,
                            strength: maxWaveAmplitude * decayFactor,
                            frequency: initialOmega * ringdownFreqFactor, // Higher frequency in ringdown
                            phase: 0,
                            ringdown: true,
                            time: currentFrame
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Update wave propagation and grid distortion
        function updateWaves() {
            // Reset grid distortions
            for (let i = 0; i < gridColumns; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < gridRows; j++) {
                    grid[i][j].distortionX = 0;
                    grid[i][j].distortionY = 0;
                    grid[i][j].x = grid[i][j].originalX;
                    grid[i][j].y = grid[i][j].originalY;
                }
            }
            
            // Update existing waves
            for (let i = waves.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const wave = waves[i];
                wave.radius += waveSpeed;
                
                // Remove waves that have gone far off-screen
                if (wave.radius > Math.hypot(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 1.2) {
                    waves.splice(i, 1);
                    continue;
                }
            }
            
            // Apply wave distortions to grid
            for (let i = 0; i < gridColumns; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < gridRows; j++) {
                    const point = grid[i][j];
                    
                    waves.forEach(wave => {
                        const dx = point.originalX - wave.x;
                        const dy = point.originalY - wave.y;
                        const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                        
                        // Only affect points near the wave front
                        const waveFrontWidth = gridSize * 1.5;
                        const distanceFromWaveFront = Math.abs(distance - wave.radius);
                        
                        if (distanceFromWaveFront < waveFrontWidth) {
                            // Smooth Gaussian-like profile for wave effect
                            const normalizedDistance = distanceFromWaveFront / waveFrontWidth;
                            const effect = Math.exp(-Math.pow(normalizedDistance * 2.5, 2)) * wave.strength;
                            
                            // Direction from wave center to point
                            const directionX = dx / Math.max(0.1, distance);
                            const directionY = dy / Math.max(0.1, distance);
                            
                            // Apply plus-cross polarization pattern
                            let angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                            
                            // For inspiral waves, apply rotation based on orbital phase
                            if (!wave.ringdown) {
                                const emissionPhase = wave.phase;
                                angle -= emissionPhase;
                            }
                            
                            // Quadrupolar pattern: GR waves have quadrupolar nature
                            // For merger/ringdown, add some cross polarization (sin(2θ))
                            let quadrupolarFactor;
                            if (wave.ringdown) {
                                // Mix of plus and cross polarization
                                quadrupolarFactor = 0.7 * Math.cos(2 * angle) + 0.3 * Math.sin(2 * angle);
                            } else {
                                quadrupolarFactor = Math.cos(2 * angle);
                            }
                            
                            // Distortion perpendicular to propagation direction
                            // This creates the characteristic stretching and squeezing of space
                            const perpX = -directionY;
                            const perpY = directionX;
                            
                            // Apply distortion
                            point.distortionX += effect * quadrupolarFactor * perpX;
                            point.distortionY += effect * quadrupolarFactor * perpY;
                        }
                    });
                    
                    // Update point position with accumulated distortions
                    point.x = point.originalX + point.distortionX;
                    point.y = point.originalY + point.distortionY;
                }

            // Draw stars

                ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${star.brightness * flicker * 0.7})`;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }
            
            // Draw grid
            const distortionIntensity = Math.min(1, currentFrame / 30); // Fade in grid
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100, 150, 255, ${0.15 * distortionIntensity})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            
            // Draw horizontal grid lines

                ctx.beginPath();
                for (let i = 0; i < gridColumns; i++) {
                    const point = grid[i][j];
                    if (i === 0) {
                        ctx.moveTo(point.x, point.y);
                    } else {
                        ctx.lineTo(point.x, point.y);
                    }
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            
            // Draw vertical grid lines
            for (let i = 0; i < gridColumns; i++) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                for (let j = 0; j < gridRows; j++) {
                    const point = grid[i][j];
                    if (j === 0) {
                        ctx.moveTo(point.x, point.y);
                    } else {
                        ctx.lineTo(point.x, point.y);
                    }
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }
            
            // Draw grid points with intensity based on distortion
            for (let i = 0; i < gridColumns; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < gridRows; j++) {
                    const point = grid[i][j];
                    const distortion = Math.hypot(point.distortionX, point.distortionY);
                    if (distortion > 0.5) {
                        const intensity = Math.min(1, distortion / (maxWaveAmplitude * 0.4));
                        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(150, 200, 255, ${intensity * 0.8 * distortionIntensity})`;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(point.x, point.y, Math.min(2, distortion * 0.15), 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Draw black holes
            if (currentFrame < mergeFrame) {
                // Two black holes
                const bhRadiusFactor = Math.min(8, gridSize * 0.2); // Visual size scaling
                
                // Accretion disk glow for first black hole
                const gradient1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    bh1.x, bh1.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m1),
                    bh1.x, bh1.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m1) * 3
                );
                gradient1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 100, 50, 0.7)');
                gradient1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 100, 50, 0)');
                
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(bh1.x, bh1.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m1) * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient1;
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Accretion disk glow for second black hole
                const gradient2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    bh2.x, bh2.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m2),
                    bh2.x, bh2.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m2) * 3
                );
                gradient2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(50, 100, 255, 0.7)');
                gradient2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(50, 100, 255, 0)');
                
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(bh2.x, bh2.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m2) * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient2;
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Black hole event horizons
                ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 150, 100, 0.8)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(bh1.x, bh1.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m1), 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.stroke();
                
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 150, 255, 0.8)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(bh2.x, bh2.y, bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m2), 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.stroke();
            } else {
                // Merged black hole
                const bhRadiusFactor = Math.min(8, gridSize * 0.2);
                const mergedRadius = bhRadiusFactor * Math.sqrt(m1 + m2);
                
                // Accretion disk shimmering
                const mergeProgress = Math.min(1, (currentFrame - mergeFrame) / 60);
                const shimmerFactor = Math.max(0, 1 - mergeProgress);
                
                // Outer glow
                const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    mergedBH.x, mergedBH.y, mergedRadius,
                    mergedBH.x, mergedBH.y, mergedRadius * 3
                );
                gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(200, 150, 255, 0.8)');
                gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100, 50, 200, 0)');
                
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(mergedBH.x, mergedBH.y, mergedRadius * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Event horizon
                ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200, 150, 255, 0.8)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(mergedBH.x, mergedBH.y, mergedRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.stroke();
                
                // Ringdown visualization - oscillating ellipses represent the remnant BH settling down
                if (currentFrame < ringdownStartFrame + 60) {
                    const ringdownProgress = (currentFrame - ringdownStartFrame) / 60;
                    const ringAmplitude = 10 * Math.exp(-ringdownProgress * 5) * shimmerFactor;
                    
                    if (ringAmplitude > 0.1) {
                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200, 150, 255, 0.4)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                        
                        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                            const oscillation = ringAmplitude * Math.sin(ringdownProgress * 50 + i * Math.PI/2);
                            
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.ellipse(
                                mergedBH.x, 
                                mergedBH.y, 
                                mergedRadius + oscillation,
                                mergedRadius - oscillation,
                                i * Math.PI/4,
                                0,
                                Math.PI * 2
                            );
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            if (currentFrame <= totalFrames) {
                updateBlackHoles();
                updateWaves();
                draw();
                currentFrame++;
                requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            } else {
                // Animation complete - restart
                setTimeout(() => {
                    currentFrame = 0;
                    waves = [];
                    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
                }, 1000);
            }
        }

        // Start animation
        animate();

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            
            // Update center coordinates
            centerX = canvas.width / 2;
            centerY = canvas.height / 2;
            mergedBH.x = centerX;
            mergedBH.y = centerY;
            
            // Recalculate responsive parameters
            const newGridSize = Math.min(Math.max(20, canvas.width / 30), 40);
            
            // Recalculate grid dimensions
            const newGridColumns = Math.ceil(canvas.width / newGridSize) + 1;
            const newGridRows = Math.ceil(canvas.height / newGridSize) + 1;
            
            // Reinitialize grid
            grid.length = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < newGridColumns; i++) {
                grid[i] = [];
                for (let j = 0; j < newGridRows; j++) {
                    const x = i * newGridSize;
                    const y = j * newGridSize;
                    grid[i][j] = {
                        originalX: x,
                        originalY: y,
                        x: x,
                        y: y,
                        distortionX: 0,
                        distortionY: 0
                    };
                }
            }
            
            // Update star positions
            stars.length = 0;
            const numStars = Math.floor(canvas.width * canvas.height / 5000);
            for (let i = 0; i < numStars; i++) {
                stars.push({
                    x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
                    y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
                    radius: Math.random() * 1.5,
                    brightness: Math.random()
                });
            }
        });
    </script>

  const c = 3e8; // speed of light (conceptual)
  const totalDuration = 30; // 30 seconds total animation
  const inspiralDuration = 20; // seconds of inspiral before merger
  const mergerDuration = 1; // seconds of merger
  const ringdownDuration = 9; // seconds of ringdown
  const canvasCount = 3;

  const bgCanvas = document.getElementById('background');
  const waveCanvas = document.getElementById('waves');
  const bhCanvas = document.getElementById('blackholes');
  const canvases = [bgCanvas, waveCanvas, bhCanvas];
  const ctxs = canvases.map(c => c.getContext('2d'));

  // Soft grid background - subtle, animated by small drifting waves
  function drawSoftGrid(ctx, time) {
    const w = ctx.canvas.width;
    const h = ctx.canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const gridSize = 40; // grid cell size in px
    const amplitude = 8;  // wave amplitude for distortion
    const waveLength = 200; // wavelength of wave distortion
    const speed = 0.2; // speed of wave drift
    
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    
    // Draw vertical lines
    for(let x=0; x <= w; x += gridSize) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for(let y=0; y <= h; y++) {
        // Distort x coordinate slightly with a sine wave in y and time
        const dx = amplitude * Math.sin((y / waveLength) * 2 * Math.PI + time * speed);
        if(y === 0) ctx.moveTo(x + dx, y);
        else ctx.lineTo(x + dx, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Draw horizontal lines
    for(let y=0; y <= h; y += gridSize) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for(let x=0; x <= w; x++) {
        // Distort y coordinate slightly with a sine wave in x and time
        const dy = amplitude * Math.sin((x / waveLength) * 2 * Math.PI + time * speed + Math.PI/2);
        if(x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y + dy);
        else ctx.lineTo(x, y + dy);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  
  // Black holes parameters (mass ratio ~1 for simplicity)
  const M1 = 30; // solar masses
  const M2 = 30;
  const totalMass = M1 + M2;
  const solarMassInMeters = 1.4767e3; // solar mass in meters (GM/c^2)
  
  // Scale factor for drawing (meters to pixels)
  // Inspiral orbit radius ~10^5 meters scaled to ~100 pixels
  // We'll use a rough scale factor for visualization
  const scaleFactor = 1e-3; // meters to pixels
  
  // Positions: center of canvas
  function getCenter() {
    return {x: waveCanvas.width/2, y: waveCanvas.height/2};
  }
  
  // Orbital frequency (Hz) approximation for circular orbit:
  // f_orb = (1/2pi) * sqrt(G(M1+M2)/r^3)
  // We'll approximate the inspiral by shrinking radius r(t) ~ (const * (t_c - t))^{1/4}
  // From Peters equations for gravitational radiation orbital decay:
  // r(t) = r0 * (1 - t/t_c)^{1/4} for t < t_c (merger time)
  
  // Initial separation in meters (typical ~300 km)
  const r0 = 3e5;
  
  // Coalescence time in seconds (matching inspiralDuration)
  const t_c = inspiralDuration;
  
  // Compute radius at time t in inspiral phase (t from 0 to t_c)
  function radiusAtTime(t) {
    if(t >= t_c) return 0;
    return r0 * Math.pow(1 - t/t_c, 0.25);
  }
  
  // Orbital frequency at radius r
  function orbitalFrequency(r) {
    if(r <= 0) return 0;
    // f = (1/2pi) * sqrt(GM/r^3)
    return (1/(2*Math.PI)) * Math.sqrt(6.67430e-11 * totalMass*1.98847e30 / (r*r*r));
  }
  
  // Phase of orbit (radians), integrated orbital freq over time
  // We'll integrate numerically with Euler method
  
  // Gravitational wave frequency = 2 * orbital frequency
  function gwFrequency(r) {
    return 2 * orbitalFrequency(r);
  }
  
  // Gravitational wave amplitude ~ (G^2 / c^4) * (M1*M2 / r) / D (distance)
  // We'll just simulate amplitude proportional to 1/r (inspiral), peak at merger, then decay
  // Distance fixed arbitrary scaling for visibility
  
  // Ringdown frequency and decay time (QNM fundamental mode)
  // Approximate ringdown frequency (Hz) for final BH ~ 1 / (2 * pi * GM/c^3)
  // For M_final ~ 60 solar masses
  // freq_ringdown ~ 250 Hz (scaled down for visualization)
  // We'll simulate ringdown as exponentially decaying sinusoid
  
  // Time tracking
  let lastTimestamp = 0;
  let elapsedTime = 0;
  
  // Orbit phase integration state
  let lastTime = 0;
  let orbitPhase = 0; // radians
  
  // Animation loop
  function animate(timestamp=0) {
    if(!lastTimestamp) lastTimestamp = timestamp;
    const dt = (timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 1000;
    lastTimestamp = timestamp;
    elapsedTime += dt;
    if(elapsedTime > totalDuration) elapsedTime = 0; // loop
    
    const w = waveCanvas.width;
    const h = waveCanvas.height;
    const center = getCenter();
    
    // Draw background grid
    drawSoftGrid(ctxs[0], elapsedTime);
    
    // Clear wave canvas
    ctxs[1].clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    
    // Clear black holes canvas
    ctxs[2].clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    
    // Parameters for animation
    let r, freq, amp, phaseIncrement;
    
    if(elapsedTime < inspiralDuration) {
      // Inspiral phase
      r = radiusAtTime(elapsedTime);
      freq = gwFrequency(r); // Hz
      // Integrate phase
      orbitPhase += 2 * Math.PI * freq * dt;
      
      // Positions of black holes in orbit (centered)
      // Mass ratio 1:1, so positions opposite sides weighted by masses:
      // x1 = +r * M2/(M1+M2) * cos(orbitPhase)
      // x2 = -r * M1/(M1+M2) * cos(orbitPhase)
      // same for y with sin
      
      const mu = M1 * M2 / totalMass; // reduced mass
      const x1 = center.x + scaleFactor * r * (M2 / totalMass) * Math.cos(orbitPhase);
      const y1 = center.y + scaleFactor * r * (M2 / totalMass) * Math.sin(orbitPhase);
      const x2 = center.x - scaleFactor * r * (M1 / totalMass) * Math.cos(orbitPhase);
      const y2 = center.y - scaleFactor * r * (M1 / totalMass) * Math.sin(orbitPhase);
      
      // Draw black holes as circles with glow
      drawBlackHole(ctxs[2], x1, y1, 14, '#222222', '#aaddff');
      drawBlackHole(ctxs[2], x2, y2, 14, '#222222', '#aaddff');
      
      // Gravitational wave amplitude (arbitrary scale for visibility)
      amp = Math.min(1, 0.6 / (r / 1e5)); // inversely proportional to radius, capped
      
      // Draw gravitational waves as ripples on grid (waveCanvas)
      drawGravitationalWave(ctxs[1], center.x, center.y, elapsedTime, amp, freq);
      
    } else if(elapsedTime < inspiralDuration + mergerDuration) {
      // Merger phase (black holes merge)
      const tMerger = elapsedTime - inspiralDuration;
      // Black holes approach center and merge
      
      // Linearly interpolate positions towards center
      const progress = tMerger / mergerDuration;
      
      const rStart = radiusAtTime(inspiralDuration - 1e-6); // just before merger
      const x1Start = center.x + scaleFactor * rStart * (M2 / totalMass) * Math.cos(orbitPhase);
      const y1Start = center.y + scaleFactor * rStart * (M2 / totalMass) * Math.sin(orbitPhase);
      const x2Start = center.x - scaleFactor * rStart * (M1 / totalMass) * Math.cos(orbitPhase);
      const y2Start = center.y - scaleFactor * rStart * (M1 / totalMass) * Math.sin(orbitPhase);
      
      const x1 = x1Start + (center.x - x1Start) * progress;
      const y1 = y1Start + (center.y - y1Start) * progress;
      const x2 = x2Start + (center.x - x2Start) * progress;
      const y2 = y2Start + (center.y - y2Start) * progress;
      
      drawBlackHole(ctxs[2], x1, y1, 16 * (1 - progress) + 24 * progress, '#111111', '#ffccaa');
      drawBlackHole(ctxs[2], x2, y2, 16 * (1 - progress) + 24 * progress, '#111111', '#ffccaa');
      
      // Wave amplitude peaks
      amp = 1 + 2 * progress; // peaks to ~3
      
      // Frequency peaks - linearly increasing to max ~ 300 Hz scaled down
      freq = 300 * progress;
      
      drawGravitationalWave(ctxs[1], center.x, center.y, elapsedTime, amp, freq);
      
    } else {
      // Ringdown phase
      const tRingdown = elapsedTime - inspiralDuration - mergerDuration;
      // Final BH at center
      
      // Draw single black hole with glowing horizon
      const glowIntensity = Math.max(0, 1 - tRingdown / ringdownDuration);
      drawBlackHole(ctxs[2], center.x, center.y, 26, `rgba(30,30,30,${glowIntensity})`, `rgba(255,200,150,${glowIntensity})`);
      
      // Ringdown frequency and decay
      const fRingdown = 250; // Hz (arbitrary scaled)
      const decayTime = ringdownDuration; // seconds
      
      // Wave amplitude exponentially decays
      amp = 3 * Math.exp(-tRingdown / decayTime);
      
      freq = fRingdown;
      
      drawGravitationalWave(ctxs[1], center.x, center.y, elapsedTime, amp, freq);
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  
  // Draw black hole with glow
  function drawBlackHole(ctx, x, y, radius, fillStyle, glowColor) {
    const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, radius*0.3, x, y, radius*1.8);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, glowColor);
    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
    
    ctx.shadowColor = glowColor;
    ctx.shadowBlur = radius * 4;
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle;
    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.arc(x, y, radius * 1.8, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }
  
  // Draw gravitational wave as ripple pattern on wave canvas
  function drawGravitationalWave(ctx, cx, cy, time, amplitude, frequency) {
    const w = ctx.canvas.width;
    const h = ctx.canvas.height;
    
    // Create a ripple effect with concentric circles modulated by wave phase
    
    // Parameters for ripple
    const maxRadius = Math.min(w, h) / 2 * 0.9;
    const rippleCount = 6;
    const baseSpeed = frequency * 2 * Math.PI * 0.3; // speed of ripple expansion
    
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    
    // Use additive blending for glow effect
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    
    for(let i = 0; i < rippleCount; i++) {
      const progress = ((time * baseSpeed) - i * (maxRadius / rippleCount)) % maxRadius;
      const radius = progress < 0 ? progress + maxRadius : progress;
      
      const alpha = amplitude * (1 - radius / maxRadius);
      if(alpha <= 0) continue;
      
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 200, 200, ${alpha * 0.12})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(255, 180, 180, ${alpha * 0.3})`;
      ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
      ctx.arc(0, 0, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    ctx.restore();
  }
  
  // Start animation
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
</script>

  height = window.innerHeight;

window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Parameters for the simulation

const fps = 60;
const totalFrames = totalTime * fps;

// Gravitational wave parameters
const waveFrequency = 2; // Hz, frequency of the wave oscillations
const ringdownStart = 10; // seconds after start
const ringdownDuration = 10; // seconds
const ringdownFreq = 0.5; // Hz, lower frequency during ringdown
const amplitudePeak = 1.2; // peak amplitude
const amplitudeInitial = 0.1; // initial amplitude
const amplitudeFinal = 0.5; // amplitude after ringdown

let startTime = null;

// Function to generate the wave amplitude over time
function waveAmplitude(t) {
  if (t < ringdownStart) {
    // Pre-ringdown: increasing amplitude
    const progress = t / ringdownStart;
    return amplitudeInitial + (amplitudePeak - amplitudeInitial) * progress;
  } else if (t < ringdownStart + ringdownDuration) {
    // Ringdown: damped oscillation
    const progress = (t - ringdownStart) / ringdownDuration;
    const damping = Math.exp(-3 * progress); // damping factor
    return amplitudePeak * damping * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * ringdownFreq * (t - ringdownStart));
  } else {
    // Post-ringdown: low amplitude oscillation
    return amplitudeFinal * Math.exp(-0.5 * (t - ringdownStart - ringdownDuration)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * waveFrequency * t);
  }
}

// Generate a grid background
const gridSize = 50;
let gridLinesX = [];
let gridLinesY = [];
for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += gridSize) {
  gridLinesX.push(x);
}
for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += gridSize) {
  gridLinesY.push(y);
}

// Animation loop
function animate(timestamp) {
  if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
  const elapsed = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000; // seconds

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

  // Draw grid background
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let x of gridLinesX) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, height);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let y of gridLinesY) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, y);
    ctx.lineTo(width, y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Draw the two black holes as moving points
  const blackHole1Pos = {
    x: width/2 + Math.sin(elapsed*0.5)*100,
    y: height/2 + Math.cos(elapsed*0.5)*100
  };
  const blackHole2Pos = {
    x: width/2 + Math.sin(elapsed*0.5 + Math.PI)*100,
    y: height/2 + Math.cos(elapsed*0.5 + Math.PI)*100
  };

  ctx.fillStyle = '#222'; // black holes appear as dark circles
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(blackHole1Pos.x, blackHole1Pos.y, 15, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(blackHole2Pos.x, blackHole2Pos.y, 15, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();

  // Calculate current wave amplitude
  const amplitude = waveAmplitude(elapsed);

  // Draw the gravitational wave as a sinusoidal oscillation across the screen
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 200, 255, 0.8)';
  ctx.beginPath();

  const waveLength = width / (waveFrequency * 2); // approximate wavelength
  const centerY = height/2;

  const points = 200; // resolution
  for (let i = 0; i <= points; i++) {
    const x = (i / points) * width;
    // Simulate the wave with a sine function modulated by amplitude
    const phase = (x / width) * Math.PI * 4 + elapsed * Math.PI * 2 * waveFrequency;
    const yOffset = amplitude * Math.sin(phase);
    ctx.lineTo(x, centerY + yOffset);
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // Optional: draw a ringdown indicator (a damped circle)
  if (elapsed >= ringdownStart && elapsed <= ringdownStart + ringdownDuration + 2) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 100, 100, 0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    const ringProgress = (elapsed - ringdownStart) / ringdownDuration;
    const radius = 50 + ringProgress * 150; // expanding ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(width/2, height/2, radius, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  if (elapsed < totalTime) {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
}

// Start the animation
requestAnimationFrame(animate);
</script>

    y1[0] = 0;
    x2[0] = D / 2;
    y2[0] = 0;

      const r = Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x2[i - 1] - x1[i - 1], 2) + Math.pow(y2[i - 1] - y1[i - 1], 2));

(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('glCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  const h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

  // Grid settings
  const gridSize = 30;          // pixels between grid lines
  const cellSize = gridSize;    // square size

  // Black‑hole settings
  const bhRadius = 20;
  const bhSpeed = (w / 2 - bhRadius) / 15; // reach center at 15s
  const bh1Start = { x: bhRadius, y: h / 2 };
  const bh2Start = { x: w - bhRadius, y: h / 2 };

  // Wave settings
  const lambda = 200;          // wavelength in pixels
  const k = 2 * Math.PI / lambda;
  const f = 0.2;               // frequency in Hz
  const omega = 2 * Math.PI * f;
  const A0 = 50;               // initial amplitude
  const tau = 5;                // decay constant for ringdown

  // Animation control
  const totalTime = 30;         // seconds
  let startTime = null;

  // Utility: compute wave amplitude at a point
  function waveAmplitude(x, y, t) {
    const dx = x - w / 2;
    const dy = y - h / 2;
    const r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    const phase = k * r - omega * t;
    const decay = t < 15 ? 1 : Math.exp(-(t - 15) / tau);
    return A0 * decay * Math.sin(phase);
  }

  // Draw the grid with modulated brightness
  function drawGrid(t) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    for (let i = 0; i <= w; i += cellSize) {
      for (let j = 0; j <= h; j += cellSize) {
        const amp = waveAmplitude(i + cellSize / 2, j + cellSize / 2, t);
        const brightness = 200 + amp; // base light gray + modulation
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${brightness}, ${brightness}, ${brightness})`;
        ctx.fillRect(i, j, cellSize, cellSize);
      }
    }
  }

  // Draw the black holes
  function drawBlackHoles(t) {
    const bh1 = { x: bh1Start.x + bhSpeed * t, y: bh1Start.y };
    const bh2 = { x: bh2Start.x - bhSpeed * t, y: bh2Start.y };
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bh1.x, bh1.y, bhRadius, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bh2.x, bh2.y, bhRadius, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
  }

  // Main loop
  function animate(timestamp) {
    if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
    const elapsed = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000; // seconds
    if (elapsed > totalTime) return; // stop after 30s

    drawGrid(elapsed);
    drawBlackHoles(elapsed);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  // Resize canvas on window resize
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;

        // Set canvas to full window size
