        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

        // Center of the canvas
        const centerX = canvas.width / 2;
        const centerY = canvas.height / 2;

        // Physical parameters (scaled for visualization)
        const G = 1; // Gravitational constant (scaled)
        const c = 10; // Speed of light (scaled)
        const M1 = 30; // Mass of first black hole
        const M2 = 30; // Mass of second black hole
        const initialSeparation = 200; // Initial separation
        const finalSeparation = 20; // Separation at merger

        // Animation parameters
        let time = 0;
        const dt = 0.05;
        const animationDuration = 30; // seconds
        const framesPerSecond = 60;
        const totalFrames = animationDuration * framesPerSecond;

        // Grid parameters
        const gridSize = 40;
        const gridSpacing = 20;
        const maxGridDistortion = 15;

        // Black hole positions
        let bh1 = { x: centerX - initialSeparation/2, y: centerY };
        let bh2 = { x: centerX + initialSeparation/2, y: centerY };
        let velocity1 = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        let velocity2 = { x: 0, y: 0 };

        // Wave parameters
        let waveAmplitude = 0;
        let waveFrequency = 0;
        let ringdownTime = 0;
        const maxAmplitude = 30;
        const maxFrequency = 0.5;

        // Inspiral parameters
        let inspiralPhase = true;
        let mergerPhase = false;
        let ringdownPhase = false;
        let mergerTime = 0;

        // Initialize velocities for inspiral
        function initializeInspiral() {
            const reducedMass = (M1 * M2) / (M1 + M2);
            const totalMass = M1 + M2;
            const v = Math.sqrt(G * totalMass / initialSeparation);
            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

            velocity1.x = -v * M2 / totalMass * Math.cos(angle);
            velocity1.y = -v * M2 / totalMass * Math.sin(angle);
            velocity2.x = v * M1 / totalMass * Math.cos(angle);
            velocity2.y = v * M1 / totalMass * Math.sin(angle);
        }

        // Calculate gravitational force
        function gravitationalForce(m1, m2, r) {
            return G * m1 * m2 / (r * r);
        }

        // Update black hole positions
        function updatePositions() {
            const dx = bh2.x - bh1.x;
            const dy = bh2.y - bh1.y;
            const r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

            if (r < finalSeparation) {
                // Merger phase
                inspiralPhase = false;
                mergerPhase = true;
                mergerTime += dt;

                if (mergerTime > 1.5) {
                    mergerPhase = false;
                    ringdownPhase = true;
                    ringdownTime += dt;
                }
            }

            if (inspiralPhase) {
                // Inspiral phase - Newtonian gravity with radiation reaction
                const force = gravitationalForce(M1, M2, r);
                const ax1 = force * dx / r / M1;
                const ay1 = force * dy / r / M1;
                const ax2 = -force * dx / r / M2;
                const ay2 = -force * dy / r / M2;

                // Radiation reaction (simplified)
                const radiationDamping = 0.001 * Math.pow(r, -4);
                velocity1.x -= radiationDamping * velocity1.x;
                velocity1.y -= radiationDamping * velocity1.y;
                velocity2.x -= radiationDamping * velocity2.x;
                velocity2.y -= radiationDamping * velocity2.y;

                // Update velocities
                velocity1.x += ax1 * dt;
                velocity1.y += ay1 * dt;
                velocity2.x += ax2 * dt;
                velocity2.y += ay2 * dt;

                // Update positions
                bh1.x += velocity1.x * dt;
                bh1.y += velocity1.y * dt;
                bh2.x += velocity2.x * dt;
                bh2.y += velocity2.y * dt;

                // Update wave parameters
                const orbitalFrequency = Math.sqrt(G * (M1 + M2) / Math.pow(r, 3));
                waveFrequency = 2 * orbitalFrequency;
                waveAmplitude = maxAmplitude * (1 - r / initialSeparation);
            } else if (mergerPhase) {
                // Merger phase - rapid amplitude increase
                waveAmplitude = maxAmplitude * (1 + 2 * mergerTime);
                waveFrequency = maxFrequency * (1 + mergerTime);

                // Black holes merge to center
                bh1.x = centerX + (bh1.x - centerX) * 0.9;
                bh1.y = centerY + (bh1.y - centerY) * 0.9;
                bh2.x = centerX + (bh2.x - centerX) * 0.9;
                bh2.y = centerY + (bh2.y - centerY) * 0.9;
            } else if (ringdownPhase) {
                // Ringdown phase - exponential decay
                const tau = 0.5; // Ringdown time constant
                waveAmplitude = maxAmplitude * 2 * Math.exp(-ringdownTime / tau);
                waveFrequency = maxFrequency * 2 * (1 - 0.5 * Math.exp(-ringdownTime / tau));

                // Final merged black hole
                bh1.x = centerX;
                bh1.y = centerY;
                bh2.x = centerX;
                bh2.y = centerY;
            }
        }

        // Draw the grid with gravitational wave distortion
        function drawGrid() {
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(50, 50, 100, 0.3)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;

            // Calculate wave distortion
            const waveDistortion = (x, y) => {
                const dx = x - centerX;
                const dy = y - centerY;
                const r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

                if (r < 10) return { dx: 0, dy: 0 };

                const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                const waveFactor = waveAmplitude * Math.exp(-r / 300) *
                                  Math.sin(waveFrequency * (r - c * time) + angle);

                return {
                    dx: waveFactor * Math.cos(angle) * 0.5,
                    dy: waveFactor * Math.sin(angle) * 0.5
                };
            };

            // Draw vertical lines
            for (let x = centerX % gridSpacing; x < canvas.width; x += gridSpacing) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                for (let y = 0; y < canvas.height; y += 5) {
                    const distortion = waveDistortion(x, y);
                    const distortedX = x + distortion.dx;
                    const distortedY = y + distortion.dy;

                    if (y === 0) {
                        ctx.moveTo(distortedX, distortedY);
                    } else {
                        ctx.lineTo(distortedX, distortedY);
                    }
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            // Draw horizontal lines
            for (let y = centerY % gridSpacing; y < canvas.height; y += gridSpacing) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                for (let x = 0; x < canvas.width; x += 5) {
                    const distortion = waveDistortion(x, y);
                    const distortedX = x + distortion.dx;
                    const distortedY = y + distortion.dy;

                    if (x === 0) {
                        ctx.moveTo(distortedX, distortedY);
                    } else {
                        ctx.lineTo(distortedX, distortedY);
                    }
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        }

        // Draw black holes
        function drawBlackHoles() {
            // Draw accretion disks
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(bh1.x, bh1.y, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            const gradient1 = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                bh1.x, bh1.y, 5,

            );
            gradient1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)');
            gradient1.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = gradient1;
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(bh2.x, bh2.y, 20, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            const gradient2 = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                bh2.x, bh2.y, 5,
                bh2.x, bh2.y, 20
            );
            gradient2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)');
            gradient2.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 255, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = gradient2;
            ctx.fill();

            // Draw event horizons
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(bh1.x, bh1.y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
            ctx.fill();

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(bh2.x, bh2.y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = 'black';

            // Draw gravitational lensing effect
            if (inspiralPhase) {
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200, 200, 255, 0.3)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;

                for (let angle = 0; angle < Math.PI * 2; angle += Math.PI / 6) {
                    const r = 30;
                    const x1 = bh1.x + r * Math.cos(angle);
                    const y1 = bh1.y + r * Math.sin(angle);
                    const x2 = bh2.x + r * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI);
                    const y2 = bh2.y + r * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI);

                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
                    ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);

        }

        // Draw the visualization
        function draw() {
            // Clear canvas with fade effect
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            // Update physics
            updatePositions();
            time += dt;

            // Draw grid with wave distortion
            drawGrid();

            // Draw black holes
            drawBlackHoles();

            // Continue animation
            if (time < animationDuration) {
                requestAnimationFrame(draw);
            }
        }

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            centerX = canvas.width / 2;
            centerY = canvas.height / 2;
        });

        // Start animation
        initializeInspiral();
        draw();
    </script>
</body>

<canvas id="gwCanvas" width="600" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
/*
  This script attempts to depict two black holes inspiraling and merging,
  accompanied by a grid that warps to simulate gravitational waves. 
  The animation lasts ~30 seconds and includes a brief ringdown. 
  For simplicity, the math is heavily approximated and purely illustrative.
*/

(function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gwCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;

  const duration = 30000; // 30 seconds in ms
  const mergeTime = 20000; // time (ms) at which they merge
  const ringdownStart = mergeTime;
  const ringdownEnd = duration;
  
  // Grid parameters
  const gridSize = 20;     // number of steps in one axis
  const spacing = W / gridSize; 
  const waveFreq = 0.003;  // base wave frequency
  const waveSpeed = 0.03;  // radial wave speed
  const maxWaveAmp = 20;   // maximum grid displacement
  
  // Black hole parameters
  const initialSeparation = 180; // distance from center to each BH at t=0
  const blackHoleSize = 8;       // radius of black holes
  const BHColor = "#FFFFFF";
  
  let start;
  
  function drawFrame(timestamp) {
    if (!start) start = timestamp;
    let elapsed = timestamp - start; 
    if (elapsed > duration) {
      elapsed = duration; 
    }
    const t = elapsed / 1000; // time in seconds for convenience
    
    // Clear
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    
    // Draw a "warped" grid to represent gravitational waves
    drawWarpedGrid(elapsed);
    
    // Draw black holes
    drawBlackHoles(elapsed);
    
    // Stop animation if time is up
    if (elapsed < duration) {
      requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
    }
  }
  
  function drawWarpedGrid(elapsed) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,200,255,0.4)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    
    // The wave amplitude and phase shift over time
    const progress = elapsed / duration;
    const waveAmplitude = maxWaveAmp * (1 - progress * 0.7); 
    // fade amplitude over final ringdown
    const ringdownFrac = Math.min(Math.max((elapsed - ringdownStart)/(ringdownEnd - ringdownStart), 0), 1);
    const ringdownDamp = 1 - ringdownFrac; 
    const effectiveAmp = waveAmplitude * ringdownDamp;
    
    // For each line in the grid, we offset its position to mimic waves
    for (let i = 0; i <= gridSize; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      // Vertical lines
      for (let j = 0; j <= gridSize; j++) {
        const x = i * spacing;
        const y = j * spacing;
        
        // Distance from center
        const dx = x - W / 2;
        const dy = y - H / 2;
        const r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        const wavePhase = waveFreq * elapsed - waveSpeed * r;
        
        // Warping
        const offset = effectiveAmp * Math.sin(wavePhase);
        
        // Shift each point radially outward or inward
        const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        const xWarped = x + offset * Math.cos(angle);
        const yWarped = y + offset * Math.sin(angle);
        
        if (j === 0) {
          ctx.moveTo(xWarped, yWarped);
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(xWarped, yWarped);
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    
    // Horizontal lines
    for (let j = 0; j <= gridSize; j++) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i <= gridSize; i++) {
        const x = i * spacing;
        const y = j * spacing;
        
        const dx = x - W / 2;
        const dy = y - H / 2;
        const r = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        const wavePhase = waveFreq * elapsed - waveSpeed * r;
        const offset = effectiveAmp * Math.sin(wavePhase);
        
        const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        const xWarped = x + offset * Math.cos(angle);
        const yWarped = y + offset * Math.sin(angle);
        
        if (i === 0) {
          ctx.moveTo(xWarped, yWarped);
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(xWarped, yWarped);
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
  
  function drawBlackHoles(elapsed) {
    const t = elapsed / 1000; // in seconds
    
    // Time fraction from 0 to 1
    const frac = elapsed / mergeTime;
    const r = Math.max(initialSeparation * (1 - frac), 0);
    
    // Approximate orbital speed acceleration near the end
    // Let angle increase from 0 to about a few revolutions
    const angle = 2 * Math.PI * t * (0.2 + 2.8 * frac); 
    
    // BH1 position
    const x1 = W/2 + r * Math.cos(angle);
    const y1 = H/2 + r * Math.sin(angle);
    // BH2 is the opposite side
    const x2 = W/2 - r * Math.cos(angle);
    const y2 = H/2 - r * Math.sin(angle);
    
    // Past mergeTime, there's essentially one black hole at the center with possible ringdown
    if (elapsed < mergeTime) {
      drawBH(x1, y1, BHColor, blackHoleSize);
      drawBH(x2, y2, BHColor, blackHoleSize);
    } else {
      // Draw one merged BH. Possibly add a slight ring to show ringdown
      // We'll draw it in the center, size could pulsate slightly
      const ringdownFrac = Math.min(Math.max((elapsed - ringdownStart)/(ringdownEnd - ringdownStart), 0), 1);
      // BH radius slightly shrinks or oscillates to indicate ringdown
      const ringdownPulse = blackHoleSize * (1 + 0.3 * Math.sin(10 * ringdownFrac));
      drawBH(W/2, H/2, BHColor, ringdownPulse);
    }
  }
  
  function drawBH(x, y, color, radius) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  
  // Start animation
  requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
})();
</script>

      // Set up canvas full screen.
      const canvas = document.getElementById("canvas");
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      function resizeCanvas() {
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      }
      window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);
      resizeCanvas();

      // Animation parameters
      const TOTAL_DURATION = 30; // seconds
      const MERGE_TIME = 15; // seconds: inspiral until merger then ringdown
      const startTime = performance.now();

      // Inspiral parameters
      const startOrbitalRadius = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) * 0.3;
      // We use a simple spiral-in: radius decreases linearly to zero by merger.
      // The orbital phase completes several revolutions.
      const ORBITAL_REVOLUTIONS = 3; // about 3 full orbits before merge

      // Ringdown parameters:
      // We will draw several ripples emanating from the center.
      const numRipples = 4;
      const ripplePeriod = 3.0; // seconds per oscillation cycle for visual pulsation
      const rippleDamping = 0.25; // damping time scale (sec^-1)
      // Let the ripple speed be such that by the end of ringdown, 
      // ripples nearly reach the canvas edge.
      const rippleSpeed = Math.sqrt(canvas.width * canvas.width + canvas.height * canvas.height) / (TOTAL_DURATION - MERGE_TIME);

      // Draw a soft grid background.
      function drawGrid() {
        const spacing = 40;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)";
        for (let x = spacing + 0.5; x < canvas.width; x += spacing) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        for (let y = spacing + 0.5; y < canvas.height; y += spacing) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, y);
          ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }

      // Draw a black hole as a filled circle.
      function drawBlackHole(x, y, radius) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#000";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Draw an expanding ripple (gravitational wave) from the center.
      function drawRipple(radius, opacity) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(200,200,255," + opacity.toFixed(3) + ")";
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Main animation loop.
      function animate(now) {
        const t = (now - startTime) / 1000; // current time in seconds
        // Clear canvas and draw grid.
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        drawGrid();

        const cx = canvas.width / 2, cy = canvas.height / 2;

        if (t < MERGE_TIME) {
          // --- Inspiral Phase: Two orbiting black holes
          // Compute the "spiral" radius parameter.
          // Linear decrease from startOrbitalRadius to near zero
          const r = startOrbitalRadius * (1 - t / MERGE_TIME);
          // Orbital phase (multiple rotations).
          const phase = 2 * Math.PI * ORBITAL_REVOLUTIONS * (t / MERGE_TIME);
          // Two holes on opposite sides.
          const bh1x = cx + r * Math.cos(phase);
          const bh1y = cy + r * Math.sin(phase);
          const bh2x = cx + r * Math.cos(phase + Math.PI);
          const bh2y = cy + r * Math.sin(phase + Math.PI);
          const bhRadius = 15;  // visual radius in pixels

          drawBlackHole(bh1x, bh1y, bhRadius);
          drawBlackHole(bh2x, bh2y, bhRadius);

          // Optionally: You could also add a very subtle distortion or faint ripple
          // around each as they orbit. For simplicity we stick with the two bodies.
        } else {
          // --- Ringdown Phase: After merger, one central black hole and expanding ripples
          const td = t - MERGE_TIME;  // time since merger

          // Draw the remnant black hole in the center.
          drawBlackHole(cx, cy, 20);

          // Draw several expanding ripples.
          for (let i = 0; i < numRipples; i++) {
            const delay = i * (ripplePeriod / 2); // stagger the ripples slightly
            if (td > delay) {
              const localTime = td - delay;
              const radius = localTime * rippleSpeed;
              // Damped oscillation for the ripple’s visibility:
              // We use an envelope: exp(-damping*time) and a cosine to give periodic modulation.
              const rippleOscillation = 0.5 + 0.5*Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * localTime / ripplePeriod);
              const opacity = Math.exp(-rippleDamping * localTime) * rippleOscillation;
              // Only draw if the ripple is visible enough.
              if (opacity > 0.02) {
                drawRipple(radius, opacity);
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // Continue animation if within total duration.
        if (t < TOTAL_DURATION) {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    </script>

  <canvas id="c"></canvas>
  <script>
    // ====== SETUP ======
    const canvas = document.getElementById('c'),
          ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let W, H;
    function resize(){
      W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // ====== PHYSICAL + ANIMATION PARAMETERS ======
    const totalDuration = 30.0;     // total run time in seconds
    const tMerge       = totalDuration * 0.95; // end of inspiral
    const tau          = tMerge;    // timescale for PN chirp
    const f0           = 20.0;      // starting GW frequency (Hz)
    const A0           = 0.0005;    // base strain amplitude
    const gridSpacing  = 50;        // px
    const r0           = Math.min(W,H)*0.25; // initial binary separation

    let startTime = null;

    // ====== CHIRP / RINGDOWN FUNCTIONS ======
    // phase φ(t) = 2π * f0*tau * [1 - (1 - t/tau)^(5/8)] / (5/8)
    function phase(t){
      const x = Math.max((tau - t)/tau, 1e-6);
      return 2*Math.PI * f0 * tau * (1 - Math.pow(x,5/8)) / (5/8);
    }
    // instantaneous GW frequency f(t) ∝ (tau_rem/tau)^(-3/8)
    function instFreq(t){
      return f0 * Math.pow(Math.max((tau - t)/tau,1e-6), -3/8);
    }
    // GW strain h(t)
    function hStrain(t){
      if(t <= tMerge){
        const f = instFreq(t);
        const A = A0 * Math.pow(f/f0,2/3);
        return A * Math.sin(phase(t));
      } else {
        // ringdown: damped sinusoid
        const tr = t - tMerge;
        const fr   = 250;   // ringdown freq
        const tauRD= 0.2;   // ringdown damping time
        const Ar   = A0 * Math.pow(instFreq(tMerge)/f0,2/3);
        return Ar * Math.exp(-tr/tauRD) * Math.sin(2*Math.PI*fr*tr);
      }
    }
    // binary separation r(t) ∝ (tau_rem/tau)^(1/4)
    function sep(t){
      if(t <= tMerge){
        const x = Math.max((tau - t)/tau,1e-6);
        return r0 * Math.pow(x,1/4);
      } else return 0;
    }

    // ====== MAIN LOOP ======
    function drawGrid(t){
      const h = hStrain(t);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,200,255,0.12)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      // vertical
      for(let x=0; x<=W+gridSpacing; x+=gridSpacing){
        ctx.beginPath();
        for(let y=0; y<=H; y+=4){
          const normY = (y - H/2) / (H/2);
          // fade edges
          const fade = Math.exp(-normY*normY * 4);
          const dx = h * gridSpacing * fade * 5;
          ctx.lineTo(x + dx, y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      // horizontal
      for(let y=0; y<=H+gridSpacing; y+=gridSpacing){
        ctx.beginPath();
        for(let x=0; x<=W; x+=4){
          const normX = (x - W/2) / (W/2);
          const fade  = Math.exp(-normX*normX * 4);
          const dy    = h * gridSpacing * fade * 5;
          ctx.lineTo(x, y + dy);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    function drawHoles(t){
      const s = sep(t);
      if(s<=1) return;
      const φ = phase(Math.min(t,tMerge)) / 2; // orbital phase
      const cx = W/2, cy = H/2;
      const x1 = cx + s*Math.cos(φ),
            y1 = cy + s*Math.sin(φ),
            x2 = cx - s*Math.cos(φ),
            y2 = cy - s*Math.sin(φ);
      // BHs
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x1,y1,8,0,2*Math.PI);
      ctx.arc(x2,y2,8,0,2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    function step(ts){
      if(!startTime) startTime = ts;
      let t = (ts - startTime)/1000;
      if(t > totalDuration) t = totalDuration;
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
      drawGrid(t);
      drawHoles(t);
      if(t < totalDuration) requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Gravitational Waves from Colliding Black Holes</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(function(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let width, height, centerX, centerY;
  let xLines = [], yLines = [];
  const spacing = 40;        // grid line spacing
  const sampleSpacing = 15;  // how finely to sample each line
  // Physical / animation parameters
  const t_c = 25;     // merger time (s)
  const totalT = 30;  // total animation length (s)
  const T0 = 8;       // initial orbital period (s)
  const omega0 = 2 * Math.PI / T0;
  const p = 0.375, factor = 1 - p;       // power for inspiral
  const K = t_c / factor;                // normalization for theta(t)
  let r0, r_min, phi0, wave_omega_final;  // will set on resize
  const A0 = 1.0;     // wave amplitude scale
  const tau = 2;      // ringdown decay time (s)
  const c = 300;      // speed of wave propagation (px/s)

  function resize(){
    width  = canvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
    height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    centerX = width  / 2;
    centerY = height / 2;
    // characteristic separations
    r0    = Math.min(width, height) * 0.4;
    r_min = r0 * 0.2;
    // phase offset at merger
    phi0 = 2 * omega0 * K;
    // final (ringdown) wave angular frequency
    const omega_final = omega0 * Math.pow(r0 / r_min, 1.5);
    wave_omega_final = 2 * omega_final;
    // rebuild grid lines
    xLines = [];
    yLines = [];
    const nX = Math.ceil(width / spacing) + 1;
    for(let i = -nX; i <= nX; i++) xLines.push(i * spacing);
    const nY = Math.ceil(height / spacing) + 1;
    for(let j = -nY; j <= nY; j++) yLines.push(j * spacing);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // orbital phase θ(t) for inspiral
  function theta(t){
    const ratio = Math.max((t_c - t) / t_c, 0);
    return omega0 * K * (1 - Math.pow(ratio, factor));
  }
  // wave amplitude at emission time
  function amplitudeAt(time){
    if(time <= 0) return 0;
    if(time <= t_c){
      let rtemp = r0 * Math.pow((t_c - time) / t_c, 0.25);
      if(rtemp < r_min) rtemp = r_min;
      return A0 * (r0 / rtemp);
    } else {
      return A0 * (r0 / r_min) * Math.exp(-(time - t_c) / tau);
    }
  }
  // wave phase at emission time
  function phaseAt(time){
    if(time <= 0) return 0;
    if(time <= t_c){
      return 2 * theta(time);
    } else {
      return phi0 + wave_omega_final * (time - t_c);
    }
  }
  // distort a single point (x,y) at observer time t
  function distort(x, y, t){
    const rx = x - centerX, ry = y - centerY;
    const r = Math.hypot(rx, ry);
    if(r < 1e-3) return {x, y};
    const emissionTime = t - r / c;
    const amp    = amplitudeAt(emissionTime);
    const phase  = phaseAt(emissionTime);
    const thetaP = Math.atan2(ry, rx);
    // quadrupolar angular dependence * sinusoidal wave
    const wave = amp * Math.cos(2 * thetaP) * Math.cos(phase);
    // radial displacement
    const dx = wave * Math.cos(thetaP);
    const dy = wave * Math.sin(thetaP);
    return { x: x + dx, y: y + dy };
  }

  // draw the softly warped grid
  function drawGrid(t){
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,200,255,0.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    // vertical lines
    for(const xBase of xLines){
      ctx.beginPath();
      let first = true;
      for(let y0 = -height/2 - sampleSpacing; y0 <= height/2 + sampleSpacing; y0 += sampleSpacing){
        const x = centerX + xBase;
        const y = centerY + y0;
        const p = distort(x, y, t);
        if(first){
          ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
          first = false;
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // horizontal lines
    for(const yBase of yLines){
      ctx.beginPath();
      let first = true;
      for(let x0 = -width/2 - sampleSpacing; x0 <= width/2 + sampleSpacing; x0 += sampleSpacing){
        const x = centerX + x0;
        const y = centerY + yBase;
        const p = distort(x, y, t);
        if(first){
          ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
          first = false;
        } else {
          ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // draw the two black holes (and final merged hole)
  function drawBHs(t){
    const rb = Math.min(width, height) * 0.02; // BH visual radius
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle   = '#000';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#88aaff';
    ctx.lineWidth   = 2;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#88aaff';
    ctx.shadowBlur  = 20;
    if(t <= t_c){
      // two inspiraling holes
      const r_sep = Math.max(r0 * Math.pow((t_c - t) / t_c, 0.25), r_min);
      const ang   = theta(t);
      const dx    = (r_sep/2) * Math.cos(ang);
      const dy    = (r_sep/2) * Math.sin(ang);
      const x1 = centerX + dx, y1 = centerY + dy;
      const x2 = centerX - dx, y2 = centerY - dy;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x1, y1, rb, 0, 2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x2, y2, rb, 0, 2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      // single merged hole
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, rb, 0, 2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // animation loop
  function animate(ts){
    if(!animate.start) animate.start = ts;
    const t = (ts - animate.start) / 1000;
    // clear
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
    // draw grid & holes
    drawGrid(t);
    drawBHs(t);
    if(t < totalT) requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

      display: block;

<body>
  <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
  <script>
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    let width, height;
    function resize() {
      width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    }
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    resize();

    // Constants
    const T_inspiral = 20;      // Seconds
    const T_ringdown = 10;      // Seconds
    const T_total = T_inspiral + T_ringdown;

    const BH_initial_sep = 0.6;
    const BH_orbits = 8;

    const A_inspiral = 0.05;
    const A_ringdown = 0.5;
    const gamma = 0.3;
    const f_ring = 2;

    const gridSpacing = 0.2;
    const gridStep = 0.05;

    // Create grid lines
    const gridLines = [];
    for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x += gridSpacing) {
      let line = [];
      for (let y = -1; y <= 1; y += gridStep) {
        line.push({ x, y });
      }
      gridLines.push(line);
    }
    for (let y = -1; y <= 1; y += gridSpacing) {
      let line = [];
      for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x += gridStep) {
        line.push({ x, y });
      }
      gridLines.push(line);
    }

    // Helper functions
    function getStrain(t) {
      if (t < T_inspiral) {
        const A = A_inspiral * Math.pow(T_inspiral / (T_inspiral - t + 0.001), 0.5);
        const theta = 2 * Math.PI * BH_orbits * (1 - Math.pow((T_inspiral - t) / T_inspiral, 5 / 8));
        return A * Math.sin(2 * theta);
      } else {
        const deltaT = t - T_inspiral;
        const A = A_ringdown * Math.exp(-gamma * deltaT);
        return A * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * f_ring * deltaT);
      }
    }

    function getBHPosition(t) {
      if (t >= T_inspiral) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
      const r = BH_initial_sep * Math.pow((T_inspiral - t) / T_inspiral, 1 / 4);
      const theta = 2 * Math.PI * BH_orbits * (1 - Math.pow((T_inspiral - t) / T_inspiral, 5 / 8));
      return {
        x: (r / 2) * Math.cos(theta),
        y: (r / 2) * Math.sin(theta)
      };
    }

    // Animation loop
    let startTime = null;

    function animate(timestamp) {
      if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
      let t = (timestamp - startTime) / 1000;
      t = t % T_total;

      // Clear canvas
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // Compute current strain
      const h = getStrain(t);

      // Draw grid
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.4)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (const line of gridLines) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        const p = line[0];
        let r = Math.sqrt(p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y);
        let h_scaled = h * (1 / (r + 0.01)) * 0.3;
        let x_distorted = p.x * (1 + h_scaled / 2);
        let y_distorted = p.y * (1 - h_scaled / 2);
        let x_screen = (x_distorted + 1) * width / 2;
        let y_screen = (1 - y_distorted) * height / 2;
        ctx.moveTo(x_screen, y_screen);

        for (let i = 1; i < line.length; i++) {
          const p = line[i];
          r = Math.sqrt(p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y);
          h_scaled = h * (1 / (r + 0.01)) * 0.3;
          x_distorted = p.x * (1 + h_scaled / 2);
          y_distorted = p.y * (1 - h_scaled / 2);
          x_screen = (x_distorted + 1) * width / 2;
          y_screen = (1 - y_distorted) * height / 2;
          ctx.lineTo(x_screen, y_screen);
        }

        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Draw black holes
      if (t < T_inspiral) {
        const bh1 = getBHPosition(t);
        const bh2 = { x: -bh1.x, y: -bh1.y };

        ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc((bh1.x + 1) * width / 2, (1 - bh1.y) * height / 2, 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc((bh2.x + 1) * width / 2, (1 - bh2.y) * height / 2, 5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(width / 2, height / 2, 7, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }

    animate();
  </script>
</body>

        const dy = h * Math.sin(y * 0.1);

 *  ─────────────
 *  Inspiral  : leading-order PN chirp  f_GW ∝ τ^{-3/8},  h ∝ τ^{-1/4}
 *  Trajectory: Peters circular-orbit    a  ∝ τ^{1/4},     φ_orb = φ_GW / 2
 *  Merger    : smooth Gaussian-peaked envelope bridging to ringdown
 *  Ringdown  : l=m=2 quasi-normal mode  h ∝ e^{-t/τ_d} cos(ω_QNM t)
 *
 *  Grid deformation uses the TT-gauge displacement
 *      ξ_x = ½ (h₊ x + hₓ y) · A(r)       ξ_y = ½ (hₓ x − h₊ y) · A(r)
 *  evaluated at retarded time  t_ret = t − r / c_vis .
 */

const c = document.getElementById('c');
const $ = c.getContext('2d');
let W, H;
const resize = () => { W = c.width = innerWidth; H = c.height = innerHeight; };
resize();
addEventListener('resize', resize);

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Constants
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const DUR   = 30;      // loop length  (s)
const T1    = 22;      // inspiral → merger
const T2    = 23;      // merger  → ringdown
const CV    = 280;     // visual "speed of light" (px s⁻¹)
const GS    = 28;      // grid spacing (px)
const R0    = 150;     // GW amplitude softening radius (px)
const DS    = 0.40;    // displacement visual scale
const F0    = 0.50;    // base GW frequency (Hz)
const A0    = 0.08;    // base strain amplitude

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Pre-computed continuous GW phase  (numerical integral)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const PDT = 0.0005;                                       // 0.5 ms resolution
const pLen = Math.ceil(DUR / PDT) + 1;
const pTbl = new Float64Array(pLen);
{
  let phi = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < pLen; i++) {
    pTbl[i] = phi;
    const t = i * PDT;
    let f;
    if      (t < T1) { const tau = Math.max(T1 - t, 1e-3); f = Math.min(F0 * Math.pow(T1 / tau, 3/8), 15); }
    else if (t < T2) { const s = (t - T1) / (T2 - T1);     f = 7 + 8 * Math.exp(-s * 5); }
    else              f = 7;
    phi += 2 * Math.PI * f * PDT;
  }
}
function getPhi(t) {
  const idx = Math.max(0, t) / PDT;
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(idx), pLen - 2);
  const fr = idx - i;
  return pTbl[i] + fr * (pTbl[i + 1] - pTbl[i]);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Background stars
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const stars = Array.from({ length: 300 }, () => ({
  x: Math.random(), y: Math.random(),
  b: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.5,
  r: 0.3  + Math.random() * 1.2,
  p: Math.random() * 6.283
}));

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GW strain  { hp, hc, amp, freq }
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function gw(t) {
  t = Math.max(0, Math.min(t, DUR - 1e-3));
  let amp, freq;
  if (t < T1) {                                        // ── inspiral ──
    const tau = Math.max(T1 - t, 1e-3), R = T1 / tau;
    freq = Math.min(F0 * Math.pow(R, 3/8), 15);
    amp  = Math.min(A0 * Math.pow(R, 1/4), 0.6);
  } else if (t < T2) {                                 // ── merger ──
    const s = (t - T1) / (T2 - T1);
    const g = Math.exp(-(s - 0.35) * (s - 0.35) / 0.04);
    amp  = 0.20 + 0.40 * (1 - s) + 0.70 * g;          // peaks ≈ 1.1, ends at 0.2
    freq = 7 + 8 * Math.exp(-s * 5);                   // 15 → 7 Hz
  } else {                                              // ── ringdown ──
    const dt = t - T2;
    amp  = 0.20 * Math.exp(-dt / 1.5);
    freq = 7;
  }
  const phi = getPhi(t);
  return { hp: amp * Math.cos(phi), hc: amp * Math.sin(phi), amp, freq };
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Black-hole positions  [{ x, y, r }, …]
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function bhs(t) {
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;

  if (t >= T2) {                                        // merged remnant
    const dt = t - T2;
    const pulse = 1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 7 * dt) * Math.exp(-dt / 1.5);
    return [{ x: cx, y: cy, r: 10 * pulse }];
  }

  const phi = getPhi(t) / 2;                            // orbital = GW / 2

  if (t >= T1) {                                        // plunge
    const s = (t - T1) / (T2 - T1), a = 12 * (1 - s);
    return [
      { x: cx + a * Math.cos(phi), y: cy + a * Math.sin(phi), r: 7 },
      { x: cx - a * Math.cos(phi), y: cy - a * Math.sin(phi), r: 7 }
    ];
  }

  const tau = Math.max(T1 - t, 1e-3);                   // inspiral
  const a = 12 + 80 * Math.pow(tau / T1, 0.25);         // a ∝ τ^{1/4}
  return [
    { x: cx + a * Math.cos(phi), y: cy + a * Math.sin(phi), r: 7 },
    { x: cx - a * Math.cos(phi), y: cy - a * Math.sin(phi), r: 7 }
  ];
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Rendering helpers
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

function drawStars(t) {
  for (const s of stars) {
    const fl = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t * 0.3 + s.p);
    $.fillStyle = `rgba(180,200,255,${(s.b * fl * 0.35).toFixed(3)})`;
    $.beginPath(); $.arc(s.x * W, s.y * H, s.r, 0, 6.283); $.fill();
  }
}

/* ── Deformed spacetime grid ── */
function drawGrid(t) {
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const nx = Math.ceil(W / GS) + 4, ny = Math.ceil(H / GS) + 4;
  const hnx = nx / 2, hny = ny / 2;

  function d(i, j) {
    const bx = (i - hnx) * GS, by = (j - hny) * GS;
    const r2 = bx * bx + by * by, r = Math.sqrt(r2);
    if (r < 0.5) return { x: cx, y: cy, s: 0 };
    const tR = t - r / CV;
    if (tR < 0) return { x: cx + bx, y: cy + by, s: 0 };
    const st = gw(tR), f = R0 * R0 / (r2 + R0 * R0);
    const hp = st.hp * f, hc = st.hc * f;
    return {
      x: cx + bx + DS * (hp * bx + hc * by),
      y: cy + by + DS * (hc * bx - hp * by),
      s: Math.sqrt(st.hp * st.hp + st.hc * st.hc) * f
    };
  }

  function lcol(ms) {
    const tn = Math.min(ms * 4, 1);
    return {
      c: `hsla(${220 - tn * 20},${50 + tn * 40}%,${30 + tn * 40}%,${(0.05 + tn * 0.65).toFixed(3)})`,
      w: 0.4 + tn * 2
    };
  }

  // horizontal grid lines
  for (let j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
    const pts = []; let ms = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) { const p = d(i, j); pts.push(p); ms = Math.max(ms, p.s); }
    $.beginPath(); $.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    for (let i = 1; i < nx; i++) $.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
    const lc = lcol(ms); $.strokeStyle = lc.c; $.lineWidth = lc.w; $.stroke();
  }

  // vertical grid lines
  for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
    const pts = []; let ms = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < ny; j++) { const p = d(i, j); pts.push(p); ms = Math.max(ms, p.s); }
    $.beginPath(); $.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
    for (let j = 1; j < ny; j++) $.lineTo(pts[j].x, pts[j].y);
    const lc = lcol(ms); $.strokeStyle = lc.c; $.lineWidth = lc.w; $.stroke();
  }

  // glowing intersection dots near wave-front
  for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) for (let j = 0; j < ny; j++) {
    const p = d(i, j);
    if (p.s > 0.04) {
      const a = Math.min(0.65, p.s * 4);
      $.fillStyle = `rgba(150,210,255,${a.toFixed(3)})`;
      $.beginPath(); $.arc(p.x, p.y, 0.8 + p.s * 2.5, 0, 6.283); $.fill();
    }
  }
}

/* ── Black holes ── */
function drawBHs(t) {
  for (const b of bhs(t)) {
    // gravitational glow
    const g1 = $.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, 0, b.x, b.y, b.r * 6);
    g1.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(50,80,170,0.22)');
    g1.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(25,50,110,0.07)');
    g1.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
    $.fillStyle = g1; $.beginPath(); $.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * 6, 0, 6.283); $.fill();

    // photon ring
    const g2 = $.createRadialGradient(b.x, b.y, b.r * 0.7, b.x, b.y, b.r * 2.3);
    g2.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(180,215,255,0.50)');
    g2.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(110,170,255,0.14)');
    g2.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
    $.fillStyle = g2; $.beginPath(); $.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * 2.3, 0, 6.283); $.fill();

    // Einstein ring
    $.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,170,0.10)'; $.lineWidth = 0.6;
    $.beginPath(); $.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r * 1.55, 0, 6.283); $.stroke();

    // event horizon
    $.fillStyle = '#000'; $.beginPath(); $.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, 6.283); $.fill();
    $.strokeStyle = 'rgba(130,180,255,0.50)'; $.lineWidth = 1;
    $.beginPath(); $.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, 6.283); $.stroke();
  }
}

/* ── Merger flash + expanding rings ── */
let flash = 0;
const rings = [];
let prevT = 0;

function drawFx(t) {
  if (t < prevT - 1) { rings.length = 0; flash = 0; }
  prevT = t;

  // flash
  if (t >= T1 && t < T2 + 0.5) {
    flash = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(t - (T1 + T2) / 2) * 4);
  } else { flash *= 0.93; }
  if (flash > 0.01) {
    const g = $.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, 0, W/2, H/2, 280);
    g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(210,230,255,${(flash * 0.30).toFixed(3)})`);
    g.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(120,165,255,${(flash * 0.10).toFixed(3)})`);
    g.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');
    $.fillStyle = g; $.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // expanding wavefront rings
  if (t >= T2 && t < T2 + 0.15 && rings.length < 4)
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) rings.push({ born: T2 + i * 0.25 });
  for (let i = rings.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const ring = rings[i];
    if (t < ring.born) continue;
    const dt = t - ring.born;
    const r = dt * CV * 0.55;
    const a = Math.max(0, 0.28 - dt * 0.065);
    const w = Math.max(0.3, 2.5 - dt * 0.35);
    if (a <= 0) { rings.splice(i, 1); continue; }
    $.strokeStyle = `rgba(140,195,255,${a.toFixed(3)})`;
    $.lineWidth = w; $.beginPath(); $.arc(W/2, H/2, r, 0, 6.283); $.stroke();
  }
}

/* ── Waveform panel ── */
function drawWave(t) {
  const px = 40, py = H - 85, pw = W - 80, ph = 50;

  $.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,8,22,0.70)';
  $.fillRect(px - 8, py - 18, pw + 16, ph + 30);
  $.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,100,180,0.12)'; $.lineWidth = 0.5;
  $.strokeRect(px - 8, py - 18, pw + 16, ph + 30);

  // zero line
  $.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,100,180,0.10)'; $.setLineDash([3, 3]);
  $.beginPath(); $.moveTo(px, py + ph / 2); $.lineTo(px + pw, py + ph / 2); $.stroke();
  $.setLineDash([]);

  const tw = 8;   // visible time window

  // h₊
  $.beginPath(); let on = false;
  for (let x = 0; x <= pw; x++) {
    const ts = t - tw + (x / pw) * tw;
    if (ts < 0) { on = false; continue; }
    const y = py + ph / 2 - gw(ts).hp * ph * 2;
    if (!on) { $.moveTo(px + x, y); on = true; } else $.lineTo(px + x, y);
  }
  $.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,185,255,0.85)'; $.lineWidth = 1.4; $.stroke();

  // hₓ
  $.beginPath(); on = false;
  for (let x = 0; x <= pw; x++) {
    const ts = t - tw + (x / pw) * tw;
    if (ts < 0) { on = false; continue; }
    const y = py + ph / 2 - gw(ts).hc * ph * 2;
    if (!on) { $.moveTo(px + x, y); on = true; } else $.lineTo(px + x, y);
  }
  $.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,165,85,0.55)'; $.lineWidth = 0.9; $.stroke();

  // labels
  $.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,155,225,0.50)'; $.font = '10px monospace';
  $.textAlign = 'right';  $.fillText('h₊', px - 10, py + ph / 2 + 3);
  $.textAlign = 'left';   $.fillText(`−${tw}s`, px, py + ph + 10);
  $.textAlign = 'right';  $.fillText('now', px + pw, py + ph + 10);
  $.textAlign = 'center'; $.fillText('STRAIN WAVEFORM', px + pw / 2, py - 5);
}

/* ── HUD overlay ── */
function drawHUD(t) {
  const s = gw(t);

  let phase, col;
  if      (t < T1) { phase = '●  INSPIRAL';  col = 'rgba(100,185,255,0.85)'; }
  else if (t < T2) { phase = '◉  MERGER';    col = 'rgba(255,215,105,0.92)'; }
  else              { phase = '○  RINGDOWN';  col = 'rgba(185,135,255,0.85)'; }

  $.textAlign = 'center'; $.fillStyle = col;
  $.font = '600 15px "Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif';
  $.fillText(phase, W / 2, 32);

  $.textAlign = 'left'; $.fillStyle = 'rgba(110,155,215,0.55)';
  $.font = '12px "Courier New",monospace';
  $.fillText(`t  = ${t.toFixed(2)} s`,   20, 25);
  $.fillText(`f  = ${s.freq.toFixed(2)} Hz`, 20, 42);
  $.fillText(`h  = ${s.amp.toFixed(4)}`,     20, 59);

  $.textAlign = 'right'; $.fillStyle = 'rgba(100,140,205,0.30)';
  $.font = '11px "Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif';
  $.fillText('Binary Black Hole Merger',            W - 20, 25);
  $.fillText('Gravitational-Wave Visualization',    W - 20, 42);
}

/* ── Vignette ── */
function drawVignette() {
  const g = $.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, Math.min(W,H)*0.25,
                                   W/2, H/2, Math.max(W,H)*0.75);
  g.addColorStop(0, 'transparent');
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,12,0.55)');
  $.fillStyle = g; $.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
}

/* ── Loop fade ── */
function drawFade(t) {
  const fd = 0.6;
  let a = 0;
  if (t > DUR - fd) a = (t - (DUR - fd)) / fd;
  else if (t < fd)  a = 1 - t / fd;
  if (a > 0.005) {
    $.fillStyle = `rgba(5,5,16,${a.toFixed(3)})`;
    $.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Animation loop
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
let t0 = null;

function frame(ts) {
  if (!t0) t0 = ts;
  const t = ((ts - t0) / 1000) % DUR;

  $.fillStyle = '#050510';
  $.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  drawStars(t);
  drawGrid(t);
  drawFx(t);
  drawBHs(t);
  drawVignette();
  drawWave(t);
  drawHUD(t);
  drawFade(t);

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Gravitational Waves • Binary Black Hole Merger</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background: #000;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            height: 100vh;
        }
        canvas {
            border: 1px solid #111;
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 100, 255, 0.1);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="canvas" width="800" height="800"></canvas>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: true });

        const WIDTH = 800;
        const HEIGHT = 800;
        const CX = WIDTH / 2;
        const CY = HEIGHT / 2;

        // Grid settings
        const GRID_COLS = 48;
        const GRID_ROWS = 48;
        const SPACING = 17;
        const gridPoints = [];

        // Initialize grid
        for (let i = 0; i < GRID_COLS; i++) {
            gridPoints[i] = [];
            for (let j = 0; j < GRID_ROWS; j++) {
                const ox = (i - GRID_COLS / 2) * SPACING;
                const oy = (j - GRID_ROWS / 2) * SPACING;
                gridPoints[i][j] = {
                    ox: ox,
                    oy: oy,
                    x: ox,
                    y: oy
                };
            }
        }

        // Simulation parameters
        const T_MERGE = 22.0;
        const TOTAL_TIME = 30.0;
        const WAVE_SPEED = 95;
        const TAU_RINGDOWN = 1.8;

        let simTime = 0;
        let lastTime = performance.now();

        function getOrbitalPhase(t) {
            if (t <= 0) return 0;
            if (t >= T_MERGE) t = T_MERGE;
            
            // Chirping frequency model (approximate post-Newtonian behavior)
            const progress = t / T_MERGE;
            const f0 = 0.35;
            const chirpStrength = 5.2;
            
            // Approximate integrated phase
            const phase = 2 * Math.PI * (
                f0 * t + 
                (chirpStrength / 2.8) * Math.pow(progress, 2.8) * t
            );
            return phase;
        }

        function getWaveform(t) {
            if (t < 0) return 0;

            if (t > T_MERGE) {
                // Ringdown
                const dt = t - T_MERGE;
                const amp = 7.5 * Math.exp(-dt / TAU_RINGDOWN);
                const freq = 3.1;
                const phaseOffset = getOrbitalPhase(T_MERGE) * 2;
                const phase = 2 * Math.PI * freq * dt + phaseOffset;
                return amp * Math.cos(phase);
            } else {
                // Inspiral + merger
                const progress = t / T_MERGE;
                const amp = 2.8 * Math.pow(progress + 0.08, 0.68);
                const phase = getOrbitalPhase(t) * 2;
                return amp * Math.cos(phase);
            }
        }

        function updateGrid() {
            const c = WAVE_SPEED;
            const strainScale = 0.028;

            for (let i = 0; i < GRID_COLS; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < GRID_ROWS; j++) {
                    const p = gridPoints[i][j];
                    const relX = p.ox;
                    const relY = p.oy;
                    const r = Math.hypot(relX, relY);

                    if (r < 8) {
                        p.x = p.ox;
                        p.y = p.oy;
                        continue;
                    }

                    const tRet = simTime - r / c;
                    let visualH = 0;

                    if (tRet > 0) {
                        const raw = getWaveform(tRet);
                        const ampFalloff = 38 / (r + 12);
                        visualH = raw * ampFalloff;
                    }

                    const theta = Math.atan2(relY, relX);
                    const cos2 = Math.cos(2 * theta);
                    const sin2 = Math.sin(2 * theta);

                    // Quadrupolar distortion (plus polarization dominant)
                    p.x = p.ox + visualH * (cos2 * relX - sin2 * relY) * strainScale;
                    p.y = p.oy + visualH * (sin2 * relX + cos2 * relY) * strainScale;
                }
            }
        }

        function drawGrid() {
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140, 200, 255, 0.45)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;

            // Horizontal lines
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let j = 0; j < GRID_ROWS; j++) {
                for (let i = 0; i < GRID_COLS - 1; i++) {
                    const p1 = gridPoints[i][j];
                    const p2 = gridPoints[i + 1][j];
                    ctx.moveTo(CX + p1.x, CY + p1.y);
                    ctx.lineTo(CX + p2.x, CY + p2.y);
                }
            }
            ctx.stroke();

            // Vertical lines
            ctx.beginPath();
            for (let i = 0; i < GRID_COLS; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < GRID_ROWS - 1; j++) {
                    const p1 = gridPoints[i][j];
                    const p2 = gridPoints[i][j + 1];
                    ctx.moveTo(CX + p1.x, CY + p1.y);
                    ctx.lineTo(CX + p2.x, CY + p2.y);
                }
            }
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        function drawBlackHoles() {
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            
            const progress = Math.min(simTime / T_MERGE, 1);
            const r = 135 * Math.pow(1 - progress * 0.92, 0.22);
            const orbitalPhase = getOrbitalPhase(simTime);

            if (simTime < T_MERGE) {
                // Two inspiraling black holes
                const x1 = r * Math.cos(orbitalPhase) * 0.5;
                const y1 = r * Math.sin(orbitalPhase) * 0.5;
                const x2 = -x1;
                const y2 = -y1;

                drawSingleBH(x1, y1, 13, '#ffaa33');
                drawSingleBH(x2, y2, 13, '#ffaa33');
            } else {
                // Merged black hole + ringdown
                const dt = simTime - T_MERGE;
                const ringdown = 4.5 * Math.exp(-dt / 1.6) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * 3.1 * dt);
                const radius = 17 + ringdown * 0.6;

                drawSingleBH(0, 0, radius, '#ffcc55');
                
                // Subtle ringdown "echo" ring
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 80, 0.15)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(CX, CY, radius + 18 + ringdown * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        }

        function drawSingleBH(relX, relY, radius, color) {
            const x = CX + relX;
            const y = CY + relY;

            // Outer glow
            ctx.shadowBlur = 22;
            ctx.shadowColor = color;
            
            // Dark core (event horizon)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0a0a';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();

            // Thin bright ring
            ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x, y, radius * 0.92, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        }

        function animate() {
            const now = performance.now();
            const delta = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
            lastTime = now;

            simTime += delta;
            if (simTime > TOTAL_TIME) {
                simTime = 0;
            }

            // Update physics
            updateGrid();

            // Render
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);

            drawGrid();
            drawBlackHoles();

            // Subtle outer glow / cosmic dust
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60, 100, 160, 0.08)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(CX, CY, 380, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();

            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        // Start animation
        animate();
    </script>
</body>

  * { margin:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; }
  body { background:#0a0a0f; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; height:100vh; }
  canvas { display:block; }
</style>

<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 1.  Canvas setup
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx    = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W, H, cx, cy;
function resize(){
  W = canvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  cx = W/2;  cy = H/2;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
resize();

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 2.  Physical (visual) parameters
// ------------------------------------------------------------
const GRID_SPACING = 30;          // px between grid lines
const WAVE_SPEED   = 300;         // px / s  (speed of the ripple)
const AMP_SCALE    = 30;          // pixel amplitude for h = 1
const DURATION     = 30_000;      // total animation length (ms)

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 3.  Gravitational‑wave strain h(t)
//     – inspiral (0 – 20 s) : frequency and amplitude rise
//     – merger   at t = 20 s
//     – ringdown (20 – 30 s): exponentially damped sinusoid
// ------------------------------------------------------------
function strain(t){
  // t is in seconds (animation time)
  if(t < 0) return 0;

  if(t <= 20){
    // simple chirp: frequency grows ~ t³, amplitude ~ t²
    const tau   = t/20;                     // 0 → 1
    const freq  = 2 + 8*tau*tau*tau;        // Hz (visual, not real)
    const amp   = 0.25 * tau*tau;          // strain amplitude
    return amp * Math.sin(2*Math.PI*freq*t);
  }

  // ringdown
  const dt = t - 20;                        // time after merger
  const dampTime = 2;                       // seconds (visual)
  const ringFreq = 5;                       // Hz (visible oscillation)
  return 1.0 * Math.exp(-dt/dampTime) * Math.cos(2*Math.PI*ringFreq*dt);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// 4.  Draw one frame
// ------------------------------------------------------------
let start = null;

function frame(ts){
  if(!start) start = ts;
  const elapsed = ts - start;               // ms
  const tNow = elapsed / 1000;              // seconds
  if(elapsed > DURATION) return;            // stop after 30 s

  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

  // faint background “glow”
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,5,20,0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // ---- draw grid with wave displacement ----
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(100,180,255,0.6)';

  const step = GRID_SPACING;

  // vertical lines
  for(let x = -cx; x <= W; x += step){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let y = 0; y <= H; y += step/2){
      const relX = x - cx;
      const relY = y - cy;
      const r    = Math.hypot(relX, relY);
      const tRet = tNow - r / WAVE_SPEED;   // retarded time
      const h    = strain(tRet);
      const dr   = h * AMP_SCALE;           // radial displacement (px)

      const nx = relX === 0 && relY === 0 ? 0 : dr * relX / (r||1);
      const ny = relX === 0 && relY === 0 ? 0 : dr * relY / (r||1);

      const sx = cx + relX + nx;
      const sy = cy + relY + ny;
      if(y===0) ctx.moveTo(sx,sy);
      else      ctx.lineTo(sx,sy);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(130,200,255,0.35)';
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // horizontal lines
  for(let y = -cy; y <= H; y += step){
    ctx.beginPath();
    for(let x = 0; x <= W; x += step/2){
      const relX = x - cx;
      const relY = y - cy;
      const r    = Math.hypot(relX, relY);
      const tRet = tNow - r / WAVE_SPEED;
      const h    = strain(tRet);
      const dr   = h * AMP_SCALE;
      const nx   = dr * relX / (r||1);
      const ny   = dr * relY / (r||1);
      const sx = cx + relX + nx;
      const sy = cy + relY + ny;
      if(x===0) ctx.moveTo(sx,sy);
      else      ctx.lineTo(sx,sy);
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(130,200,255,0.35)';
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // ---- centre marker (merger flash) ----
  if(tNow > 19.8 && tNow < 20.4){
    const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(tNow-20)/0.3);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx,cy, 120*alpha, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.6*alpha})`;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // ---- time label ----
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,220,255,0.7)';
  ctx.font = '18px monospace';
  ctx.fillText(`t = ${tNow.toFixed(2)} s`, 12, H-12);

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

        const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

        // Physical parameters (simplified)
        const G = 6.67430e-11;
        const c = 299792458;
        const M = 30 * 1.9885e30; // Total mass in kg (30 solar masses)
        const rSchwarzschild = 2 * G * M / (c * c); // Schwarzschild radius
        const D = 1e9 * 9.461e15; // Distance to observer (1 Gpc)
        const wavelength = 2 * Math.PI * D / 100; // Approx wavelength at 100 Hz

        // Animation parameters
        let time = 0;
        const duration = 30; // seconds
        const blackHoles = [
            { mass: 0.6 * M, x: 0.3, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, color: '#4fc3f7' },
            { mass: 0.4 * M, x: -0.3, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, color: '#ff7043' }
        ];
        let separation = 10 * rSchwarzschild; // Initial separation
        let merged = false;
        let ringdownTime = 0;

        // Grid parameters
        const gridSize = 40;
        const gridSpacing = Math.min(canvas.width, canvas.height) / gridSize;
        const grid = [];
        for (let i = 0; i <= gridSize; i++) {
            grid[i] = [];
            for (let j = 0; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                grid[i][j] = { 
                    x: i * gridSpacing - canvas.width/2, 
                    y: j * gridSpacing - canvas.height/2,
                    dispX: 0, 
                    dispY: 0 
                };
            }
        }

        function updateBlackHoles() {
            if (merged) return;

            // Simplified inspiral using Keplerian orbits with energy loss
            const reducedMass = (blackHoles[0].mass * blackHoles[1].mass) / M;
            const orbitalPeriod = 2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(separation**3 / (G * M));
            const angularVelocity = 2 * Math.PI / orbitalPeriod;
            
            // Update positions (circular orbit approximation)
            const angle = angularVelocity * time;
            const x1 = (blackHoles[0].mass / M) * separation/2 * Math.cos(angle);
            const y1 = (blackHoles[0].mass / M) * separation/2 * Math.sin(angle);
            const x2 = -(blackHoles[1].mass / M) * separation/2 * Math.cos(angle);
            const y2 = -(blackHoles[1].mass / M) * separation/2 * Math.sin(angle);

            blackHoles[0].x = x1;
            blackHoles[0].y = y1;
            blackHoles[1].x = x2;
            blackHoles[1].y = y2;

            // Decrease separation (simplified energy loss)
            separation *= 1 - 1e-8 * (1 - time/duration);

            // Check for merger
            if (separation < 1.5 * rSchwarzschild) {
                merged = true;
                ringdownTime = time;
            }
        }

        function updateGrid() {
            // Clear displacements
            for (let i = 0; i <= gridSize; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                    grid[i][j].dispX = 0;
                    grid[i][j].dispY = 0;
                }
            }

            if (!merged) {
                // Inspiral phase - quadrupole formula approximation
                const dt = 0.01;
                const hPlus = (4 * G * reducedMass * (angularVelocity * separation)**2 / (c**4 * D)) * 
                             Math.cos(2 * (angularVelocity * time)) * Math.exp(-time/10);
                const hCross = (4 * G * reducedMass * (angularVelocity * separation)**2 / (c**4 * D)) * 
                             Math.sin(2 * (angularVelocity * time)) * Math.exp(-time/10);

                // Apply wave displacement to grid
                for (let i = 0; i <= gridSize; i++) {
                    for (let j = 0; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                        const x = grid[i][j].x;
                        const y = grid[i][j].y;
                        const r = Math.sqrt(x*x + y*y);
                        if (r > 0) {
                            const phi = Math.atan2(y, x);
                            grid[i][j].dispX = hPlus * x - hCross * y;
                            grid[i][j].dispY = hPlus * y + hCross * x;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                // Ringdown phase - quasi-normal modes
                const t = time - ringdownTime;
                const freq = 0.04 * c / rSchwarzschild; // Approx QNM frequency
                const decay = 5 / (rSchwarzschild / c); // Approx decay time
                const amplitude = Math.exp(-t * decay) * Math.sin(freq * t * 2 * Math.PI);

                // Apply ringdown displacement (radial pattern)
                for (let i = 0; i <= gridSize; i++) {
                    for (let j = 0; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                        const x = grid[i][j].x;
                        const y = grid[i][j].y;
                        const r = Math.sqrt(x*x + y*y);
                        if (r > 0) {
                            const displacement = amplitude * r / 100;
                            grid[i][j].dispX = (x / r) * displacement;
                            grid[i][j].dispY = (y / r) * displacement;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        function draw() {
            // Clear canvas
            ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            // Update physics
            updateBlackHoles();
            updateGrid();

            // Draw grid with displacements
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100, 100, 255, 0.2)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;

            for (let i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
                for (let j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                    const p1 = grid[i][j];
                    const p2 = grid[i+1][j];
                    const p3 = grid[i][j+1];

                    // Horizontal line
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(p1.x + p1.dispX, p1.y + p1.dispY);
                    ctx.lineTo(p2.x + p2.dispX, p2.y + p2.dispY);
                    ctx.stroke();

                    // Vertical line
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(p1.x + p1.dispX, p1.y + p1.dispY);
                    ctx.lineTo(p3.x + p3.dispX, p3.y + p3.dispY);
                    ctx.stroke();
                }
            }

            // Draw black holes
            blackHoles.forEach(bh => {
                const x = bh.x;
                const y = bh.y;
                const size = 10 * rSchwarzschild / (1e9 * 9.461e15) * canvas.width; // Scale to view

                // Event horizon
                ctx.fillStyle = bh.color;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(canvas.width/2 + x, canvas.height/2 + y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                // Accretion disk (visual effect)
                ctx.strokeStyle = bh.color;
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(canvas.width/2 + x, canvas.height/2 + y, size * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.stroke();
            });

            // Continue animation
            time += 1/60;
            if (time < duration) {
                requestAnimationFrame(draw);
            } else {
                // Optional: loop the animation
                time = 0;
                separation = 10 * rSchwarzschild;
                merged = false;
                requestAnimationFrame(draw);
            }
        }

        // Start animation
        const reducedMass = (blackHoles[0].mass * blackHoles[1].mass) / M;
        draw();

        // Handle window resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            // Recreate grid with new dimensions
            const newGrid = [];
            for (let i = 0; i <= gridSize; i++) {
                newGrid[i] = [];
                for (let j = 0; j <= gridSize; j++) {
                    newGrid[i][j] = { 
                        x: i * gridSpacing - canvas.width/2, 
                        y: j * gridSpacing - canvas.height/2,
                        dispX: 0, 
                        dispY: 0 
                    };
                }
            }
            // In a real implementation, you'd need to transfer displacements
            // This simplified version just restarts the animation
            time = 0;
            separation = 10 * rSchwarzschild;
            merged = false;
            draw();
        });
    </script>
</body>
