"use strict";
/* ============================================================
   PHYSICS MODEL (visual units; time stretched ~100x vs GW150914)
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Inspiral (quadrupole radiation reaction):
     a(t)      ∝ (tc - t)^(1/4)          (separation decay)
     ω_orb(t)  ∝ (tc - t)^(-3/8)         (Kepler: ω² a³ = GM)
     f_GW      = 2 f_orb                 (quadrupole)
     h(t)      ∝ (M ω)^(2/3) / r         (leading-order strain)
   Propagation: h evaluated at retarded time t - r/c (outward
     two-armed spiral; circular polarization, face-on view).
   Merger: when separation reaches the sum of horizon radii.
   Ringdown: damped l=m=2 quasi-normal mode of the Kerr remnant,
     a* ≈ 0.69, Q ≈ 3.2, M_f ≈ 0.95 M (≈5% radiated), τ = 2Q/ω.
   ============================================================ */
const T_LOOP = 30, tm = 21;                       // loop length, merger time (s)
const fgw0  = 0.40, wgw0 = 2*Math.PI*fgw0;        // initial GW frequency
const tauF  = 0.52;                               // chirp regulator -> sets peak freq
const wPeak = wgw0 * Math.pow(tm/tauF, 3/8);      // GW freq at merger
const wRD   = 1.25 * wPeak;                       // QNM slightly above peak freq
const Q220  = 3.2, tauRD = 2*Q220/wRD;            // ringdown damping time
const Apeak = Math.pow(wPeak/wgw0, 2/3);
const mergeBlend = 0.15;

const sm = x => { x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x)); return x*x*(3-2*x); };

function omegaGW(t){
  if (t < tm){
    const tau = tm - t, te = Math.sqrt(tau*tau + tauF*tauF);
    return wgw0 * Math.pow(tm/te, 3/8);           // chirp: ω ∝ (tc-t)^(-3/8)
  }
  return wPeak + (wRD - wPeak) * sm((t - tm)/mergeBlend);
}
function ampGW(t){
  if (t < tm) return Math.pow(omegaGW(t)/wgw0, 2/3) * sm(t/4); // h ∝ ω^(2/3), soft turn-on for seamless loop
  return Apeak * Math.exp(-(t - tm)/tauRD);                    // exponential ringdown
}

/* --- Precompute phase Φ(t) = ∫ω dt on a fine table (exact continuity) --- */
const T0=-12, T1=31, NT=8600, DT=(T1-T0)/NT;
const PHI = new Float64Array(NT+1), AMP = new Float32Array(NT+1);
{
  let p = 0, wprev = omegaGW(T0);
  PHI[0]=0; AMP[0]=ampGW(T0);
  for (let i=1;i<=NT;i++){
    const t = T0 + i*DT, w = omegaGW(t);
    p += 0.5*(w+wprev)*DT; wprev = w;
    PHI[i]=p; AMP[i]=ampGW(t);
  }
}
function wavePhase(t){ let x=(t-T0)/DT; x=x<0?0:(x>NT-1?NT-1:x); const i=x|0,f=x-i; return PHI[i]+(PHI[i+1]-PHI[i])*f; }
function waveAmp(t){  let x=(t-T0)/DT; x=x<0?0:(x>NT-1?NT-1:x); const i=x|0,f=x-i; return AMP[i]+(AMP[i+1]-AMP[i])*f; }

/* --- Binary parameters & trajectories --- */
const m1=1.15, m2=0.85, M=m1+m2;                 // mass ratio q ≈ 1.35
const a0 = 130;                                  // initial separation (px)
const Rbh = m => 26*m;                           // visual horizon radius ∝ m
const Mf = 0.95*M, spinF = 0.69;
const Rf = 26*Mf*(1+Math.sqrt(1-spinF*spinF))/2; // Kerr r+ = M(1+√(1-a*²))

function sep(t){ const w = omegaGW(Math.min(t,tm)); return a0*Math.pow(wgw0/w, 2/3); } // Kepler: a ∝ ω^(-2/3)
function bhPos(t, out){
  const tc = Math.min(t, tm);
  const a = sep(tc), phi = wavePhase(tc)/2;      // orbital phase = Φ_GW / 2
  const c = Math.cos(phi), s = Math.sin(phi);
  const r1 = a*m2/M, r2 = a*m1/M;                // barycentric distances
  let f = t > tm ? 1 - sm((t-tm)/0.25) : 1;      // settle to center after merger
  out[0]= r1*c*f; out[1]= r1*s*f; out[2]=-r2*c*f; out[3]=-r2*s*f;
}

/* --- Sanity checks (see console) --- */
(function selfTest(){
  const wo = t => omegaGW(t)/2, k = t => wo(t)*wo(t)*Math.pow(sep(t),3);
  console.assert(Math.abs(k(2)/k(18)-1) < 1e-9, "Kepler ω²a³ const FAILED");
  console.assert(Math.abs(sep(tm) - (Rbh(m1)+Rbh(m2))) < 2.5,
    "Contact at merger: a_min="+sep(tm).toFixed(1)+" vs R1+R2="+(Rbh(m1)+Rbh(m2)).toFixed(1));
  console.assert(Math.abs(waveAmp(tm-1e-4)-waveAmp(tm+1e-4)) < 1e-3, "Amplitude continuity at merger FAILED");
  const r = omegaGW(10.5)/omegaGW(0), e = Math.pow((tm)/(tm-10.5), 3/8); // chirp exponent check
  console.assert(Math.abs(r/e-1) < 0.01, "Chirp exponent -3/8 FAILED");
  console.log("[GW sanity] Kepler ✓  contact-at-merger ✓  chirp(-3/8) ✓  amp-continuity ✓  Q="+Q220+" τ_rd="+tauRD.toFixed(2)+"s");
})();

/* ============================ RENDERING ============================ */
const cv = document.getElementById('c'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
const CVIS = 200;            // visual wave speed (px/s)
const DISP = 13;             // displacement scale
const DMAX = 0.5*Apeak*DISP; // peak displacement (px)
let W,H,cx,cy,SP,cols,rows,gx0,gy0,PX,PY,BS,bgGrad;
const DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 1.5);

const DOTS = []; for(let i=0;i<=12;i++){const u=i/12;
  DOTS.push(`rgba(${(140+95*u)|0},${(200+45*u)|0},255,${(0.05+0.8*u).toFixed(3)})`);}

function resize(){
  W = innerWidth; H = innerHeight;
  cv.width = W*DPR; cv.height = H*DPR;
  cv.style.width = W+'px'; cv.style.height = H+'px';
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  cx = W/2; cy = H/2;
  SP = Math.max(22, Math.min(34, W/64));
  cols = Math.ceil(W/SP)+3; rows = Math.ceil(H/SP)+3;
  gx0 = (W - (cols-1)*SP)/2; gy0 = (H - (rows-1)*SP)/2;
  const n = cols*rows;
  PX = new Float32Array(n); PY = new Float32Array(n); BS = new Float32Array(n);
  bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,Math.hypot(cx,cy));
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#071021'); bgGrad.addColorStop(0.6,'#040810'); bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#02040a');
}
addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

function computeGrid(t){
  let k = 0;
  for (let j=0;j<rows;j++){
    const Y = gy0 + j*SP, dy = Y - cy;
    for (let i=0;i<cols;i++,k++){
      const X = gx0 + i*SP, dx = X - cx;
      const r = Math.hypot(dx,dy) || 1e-6;
      const tr = t - r/CVIS;                               // retarded time
      let x = (tr-T0)/DT; x = x<0?0:(x>NT-1?NT-1:x);
      const ii = x|0, ff = x-ii;
      const phi = PHI[ii]+(PHI[ii+1]-PHI[ii])*ff;
      const A   = AMP[ii]+(AMP[ii+1]-AMP[ii])*ff;
      const g = 0.5*A*DISP * r/(r+90);                     // δ_i = ½ h_ij x_j (softened near origin)
      const hp = Math.cos(phi), hx = Math.sin(phi);        // h+ , h×  (circular pol., face-on)
      const ux = dx/r, uy = dy/r;
      PX[k] = X + g*(hp*ux + hx*uy);
      PY[k] = Y + g*(hx*ux - hp*uy);
      BS[k] = Math.min(1, g/DMAX);
    }
  }
}

function drawGrid(){
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(96,150,255,0.14)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let j=0;j<rows;j++){ let k=j*cols;
    ctx.moveTo(PX[k],PY[k]);
    for (let i=1;i<cols;i++){k++; ctx.lineTo(PX[k],PY[k]);}}
  for (let i=0;i<cols;i++){ let k=i;
    ctx.moveTo(PX[k],PY[k]);
    for (let j=1;j<rows;j++){k+=cols; ctx.lineTo(PX[k],PY[k]);}}
  ctx.stroke();
  for (let k=0;k<PX.length;k++){
    const b = (BS[k]*12)|0; if (b<1) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = DOTS[b];
    ctx.fillRect(PX[k]-1, PY[k]-1, 2, 2);
  }
}

function drawBH(x,y,R,sx,sy,ang){
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.rotate(ang); ctx.scale(sx,sy);
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,R*0.6,0,0,R*2.8);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,176,96,0.50)'); g.addColorStop(0.45,'rgba(255,140,70,0.12)');
  g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,140,70,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,R*2.8,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,214,160,0.85)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,R*1.16,0,7); ctx.stroke();      // photon ring
  ctx.fillStyle='#000'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,R,0,7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

const pos = new Float64Array(4);
function drawBodies(t){
  if (t < tm){
    if (t < tm + 1.2){                                          // fading inspiral trails
      const n=60, dtt=0.05;
      ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
      for (let b=0;b<2;b++){
        let prev=null;
        for (let k=n;k>=0;k--){
          const ts=t-k*dtt; if (ts<0.2) continue;
          bhPos(ts,pos);
          const x=cx+pos[b*2], y=cy+pos[b*2+1];
          if (prev){
            ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${b?160:255},${b?200:190},${b?255:140},${(0.30*(1-k/n)).toFixed(3)})`;
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(prev[0],prev[1]); ctx.lineTo(x,y); ctx.stroke();
          }
          prev=[x,y];
        }
      }
    }
    bhPos(t,pos);
    drawBH(cx+pos[0],cy+pos[1],Rbh(m1),1,1,0);
    drawBH(cx+pos[2],cy+pos[3],Rbh(m2),1,1,0);
  } else {
    const dtmm = t - tm;
    const e = 0.15*Math.exp(-dtmm/tauRD)*Math.cos(wRD*dtmm);    // QNM shape oscillation
    const grow = 0.75 + 0.25*sm(dtmm/0.3);
    drawBH(cx,cy,Rf*grow,1+e,1-e,wavePhase(tm)/2);
    if (dtmm < 2.5){                                            // expanding wavefront marker
      const a = 0.55*Math.exp(-dtmm/0.45);
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,230,190,${a.toFixed(3)})`; ctx.lineWidth=2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,Math.max(Rf,CVIS*dtmm),0,7); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

function drawStrain(t){
  const cw=Math.min(560,W-60), ch=58, x0=(W-cw)/2, y0=H-ch-44;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,160,220,0.25)';
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0,y0+ch/2); ctx.lineTo(x0+cw,y0+ch/2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(120,225,255,0.9)'; ctx.lineWidth=1.4; ctx.beginPath();
  const n=280, span=9;
  for (let i=0;i<=n;i++){
    const ts=t-span+span*i/n;
    const v=waveAmp(ts)*Math.cos(wavePhase(ts))/Apeak;
    const x=x0+cw*i/n, y=y0+ch/2-v*ch*0.48;
    i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y);
  }
  ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,190,235,0.55)';
  ctx.font='10px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace';
  ctx.fillText('strain  h(t)  — last 9 s', x0, y0-6);
}

function drawHUD(t){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(210,230,255,0.92)';
  ctx.font='600 15px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace';
  ctx.fillText('BINARY BLACK HOLE COALESCENCE', 26, 36);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,190,235,0.6)';
  ctx.font='11px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace';
  ctx.fillText('quadrupole gravitational waves · retarded-time field · time-stretched ≈100×', 26, 54);
  ctx.fillText('a∝(tc−t)^¼ · f_GW=2f_orb∝(tc−t)^−⅜ · h∝ω^⅔ · ringdown: ℓ=m=2 QNM, a*≈0.69, Q≈3.2, M_f≈0.95M', 26, H-18);
  let label = t<18 ? 'INSPIRAL' : t<tm-0.05 ? 'LATE INSPIRAL · PLUNGE'
            : t<tm+0.5 ? 'MERGER' : t<tm+4 ? 'RINGDOWN' : 'REMNANT KERR BLACK HOLE';
  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillStyle = t>tm-0.4 && t<tm+0.6 ? 'rgba(255,220,170,0.95)' : 'rgba(160,220,255,0.85)';
  ctx.font='600 13px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace';
  ctx.fillText(label, W-26, 36);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,190,235,0.6)'; ctx.font='11px ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace';
  const f = omegaGW(Math.min(t, tm+0.2))/(2*Math.PI);
  ctx.fillText(`f_GW ≈ ${f.toFixed(2)} Hz  (≈ ${(f*100)|0} Hz physical)`, W-26, 54);
  ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,170,255,0.25)'; ctx.fillRect(0,H-3,W,3);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(140,210,255,0.8)'; ctx.fillRect(0,H-3,W*t/T_LOOP,3);
}

const t0 = performance.now();
(function frame(now){
  const t = ((now - t0)/1000) % T_LOOP;
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  computeGrid(t);
  drawGrid();
  drawBodies(t);
  drawStrain(t);
  drawHUD(t);
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})(t0);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Gravitational Waves: Binary Black Hole Merger</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { background: #000; overflow: hidden; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W, H, scale, stars = [];

function resize() {
  W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  const physHalf = 42;
  scale = Math.min(W, H) / (2 * physHalf);
  genStars();
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// ========== Physical parameters (G = c = 1 units) ==========
// Equal-mass nonspinning BBH. Leading-order quadrupole radiation reaction
// (Peters 1964). Face-on view (max GW amplitude). Trajectories: CM fixed,
// circular adiabatic inspiral until r_merge, then instantaneous merger + QNM ringdown.
// Sanity: v/c starts ~0.16 ends ~0.29; r(t) = (r0^4 - k t)^{1/4}; Lz decreases only via GW;
// energy loss matches quadrupole formula; no unphysical crossings.
const M = 1.0;
const mu = 0.25;
const r0 = 10.0;
const k = (256 / 5) * mu * M * M;          // r^4(t) = r0^4 - k t
const t_coal = Math.pow(r0, 4) / k;        // ~781.25
const r_merge = 3.0;                       // inside ISCO~6; residual time small
const tau = 80.0;                          // ringdown damping (stretched for visibility)
const omega_rd = 0.30;                     // remnant QNM orbital proxy (GW freq ~0.6/M)
const dt = 0.05;
const amp_factor = 14.0;                    // overall visual gain (real h ~ 10^{-21})
const h_limit = 0.85;                      // prevent extreme folding

// Precompute trajectory (high accuracy, fixed dt)
const traj = [];
let t = 0, phi = 0, merged = false, t_merge = 0, A_merge = 0;
while (true) {
  let r, om, A;
  if (!merged) {
    const r4 = Math.pow(r0, 4) - k * t;
    if (r4 <= Math.pow(r_merge, 4)) {
      merged = true;
      t_merge = t;
      r = r_merge;
      om = Math.sqrt(M / (r * r * r));
      A_merge = 4 * mu * r * r * om * om;
      A = A_merge;
    } else {
      r = Math.pow(r4, 0.25);
      om = Math.sqrt(M / (r * r * r));
      A = 4 * mu * r * r * om * om;
    }
  } else {
    r = 0;
    const t_ring = t - t_merge;
    A = A_merge * Math.exp(-t_ring / tau);
    om = omega_rd;
    if (t_ring > 5.2 * tau) break;
  }
  traj.push({ t, r, phi, A, om, merged });
  phi += om * dt;
  t += dt;
  if (t > 2500) break;
}
const t_final = traj[traj.length - 1].t;
const speed = t_final / 30.0;              // exactly 30 s real-time to end of ringdown

function getState(tt) {
  if (tt <= 0) return traj[0];
  if (tt >= t_final) return traj[traj.length - 1];
  const idx = Math.min(Math.floor(tt / dt), traj.length - 2);
  const s0 = traj[idx];
  const s1 = traj[idx + 1];
  const f = (tt - s0.t) / dt;
  return {
    r: s0.r + f * (s1.r - s0.r),
    phi: s0.phi + f * (s1.phi - s0.phi),
    A: s0.A + f * (s1.A - s0.A),
    merged: s0.merged || s1.merged
  };
}

function getDisplacement(x, y, physT) {
  let R = Math.hypot(x, y);
  if (R < 0.15) R = 0.15;
  const t_ret = Math.max(0, physT - R);   // retarded time (c=1)
  const st = getState(t_ret);
  let hp = -(st.A / R) * Math.cos(2 * st.phi);
  let hx = -(st.A / R) * Math.sin(2 * st.phi);
  hp *= amp_factor;
  hx *= amp_factor;
  hp = Math.max(-h_limit, Math.min(h_limit, hp));
  hx = Math.max(-h_limit, Math.min(h_limit, hx));
  // Strain displacement (face-on +/× polarizations)
  const dx = 0.5 * (hp * x + hx * y);
  const dy = 0.5 * (hx * x - hp * y);
  return { dx, dy };
}

function genStars() {
  stars = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 280; i++) {
    stars.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: Math.random() * 1.1 + 0.25,
      a: Math.random() * 0.55 + 0.15
    });
  }
}

function drawBlackHole(sx, sy, rad) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(sx, sy, 0, sx, sy, rad * 1.7);
  g.addColorStop(0.0, 'rgba(0,0,0,1)');
  g.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(5,0,15,0.95)');
  g.addColorStop(0.8, 'rgba(30,10,50,0.5)');
  g.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgba(80,40,120,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(sx, sy, rad * 1.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Horizon
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(sx, sy, rad, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  // Soft photon-ring glow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;

  for(const m of [TC-TAU_M,TC,TC+6.5]) ctx.fillRect(W*m/T_END-0.5,H-6,1,6);

  ctx.textAlign='right';
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(150,170,205,0.35)';
  ctx.font='10px "Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('click / space = pause · R = replay',W-16,H-14);
}

/* ------------------------------ main loop ------------------------------ */
let startT=performance.now(), accPause=0, pauseStart=0, paused=false, lastT=0;
function simNow(){ return ((paused?pauseStart:performance.now())-startT-accPause)/1000; }

function frame(){
  const raw=simNow();
  const t=raw%(T_END+1.4);
  if(t<lastT-1){ trail1.length=0; trail2.length=0; }   // looped
  lastT=t;

  ctx.fillStyle=bgGrad; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  deformGrid(Math.min(t,T_END));
  strokeGrid();

  // black holes
  const a=sepBH(t), Phi=phaseAt(t)/2;
  if(a>0){
    const r=a/2, c=Math.cos(Phi), s=Math.sin(Phi);
    const x1=CX+r*c, y1=CY+r*s, x2=CX-r*c, y2=CY-r*s;
    if(!paused){
      trail1.push([x1,y1]); trail2.push([x2,y2]);
      if(trail1.length>160){ trail1.shift(); trail2.shift(); }
    }
    drawTrail(trail1,'190,160,255');
    drawTrail(trail2,'190,160,255');
    drawBH(x1,y1,12,1); drawBH(x2,y2,12,1);
  }else{
    trail1.length=0; trail2.length=0;
    const shimmer=1+0.03*ampAt(t)*Math.cos(phaseAt(t));   // QNM shimmer on the ring
    drawBH(CX,CY,23,sstep((t-TC)/0.3),shimmer);
  }
  drawMergerFx(t);

  drawInset(t);
  drawHUD(t);

  // fades (in at start, out at 30 s, then loop)
  const cover=Math.max(1-sstep(t/0.9), sstep((t-T_END)/1.2));
  if(cover>0){ ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(4,6,13,${cover.toFixed(3)})`; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H); }

  if(paused){
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(220,230,245,0.7)';
    ctx.font='300 13px "Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('❚❚  paused',CX,70);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

function togglePause(){
  if(paused){ accPause+=performance.now()-pauseStart; paused=false; }
  else{ pauseStart=performance.now(); paused=true; }
}
function restart(){
  startT=performance.now(); accPause=0; paused=false;
  trail1.length=0; trail2.length=0; lastT=0;
}
cv.addEventListener('click',togglePause);
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.code==='Space'){ e.preventDefault(); togglePause(); }
  if(e.key==='r'||e.key==='R') restart();
});

resize();
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Generate a beautiful, 30-second soft grid animation in HTML visualizing gravitational waves from two colliding black holes including ringdown. Maximize physical accuracy and sanity check the trajectories. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Gravitational Waves — Binary Black Hole Merger</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #030308; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // ---- physical / timing model (geometric units scaled to visual slow-motion) ----
  const T_MERGE = 20.5;
  const DURATION = 30;
  const PERIOD0 = 3.55;
  const OMEGA0 = 2 * Math.PI / PERIOD0;
  const FRAC_CAP = 0.155;          // freeze Kepler frequency below this separation (plunge)
  const TAU_RD = 1.42;             // QNM e-folding time (several visible ringdown cycles)
  const T0_PRE = -6;
  const PRE_DT = 0.004;
  const PRE_N = Math.ceil((DURATION + 2 - T0_PRE) / PRE_DT);

  const preFrac = new Float32Array(PRE_N);
  const prePhi  = new Float32Array(PRE_N);
  const preChirp = new Float32Array(PRE_N);
  const preWPh  = new Float32Array(PRE_N);

  // Precompute PN inspiral (a ∝ τ^{1/4}, Ω ∝ a^{-3/2}) + matched QNM ringdown
  {
    let phi = OMEGA0 * T0_PRE;
    let lastChirp = 1;
    let lastWPh = 2 * phi;
    let lastOm = OMEGA0;
    const omCap = OMEGA0 * Math.pow(1 / FRAC_CAP, 1.5);
    const omegaRd = 2 * omCap * 1.045; // 220-mode slightly above last GW frequency

    for (let i = 0; i < PRE_N; i++) {
      const tt = T0_PRE + i * PRE_DT;
      if (tt <= T_MERGE) {
        const u = Math.max(0, 1 - tt / T_MERGE);
        const frac = u > 0 ? Math.pow(u, 0.25) : 0;
        preFrac[i] = frac;
        const fUse = Math.max(frac, FRAC_CAP);
        const om = OMEGA0 * Math.pow(1 / fUse, 1.5);
        prePhi[i] = phi;
        preChirp[i] = 1 / fUse;          // ∝ f^{2/3}
        preWPh[i] = 2 * phi;
        lastChirp = preChirp[i];
        lastWPh = preWPh[i];
        lastOm = om;
        phi += om * PRE_DT;
      } else {
        const dtm = tt - T_MERGE;
        preFrac[i] = 0;
        prePhi[i] = 0;
        preChirp[i] = lastChirp * Math.exp(-dtm / TAU_RD);
        preWPh[i] = lastWPh + omegaRd * dtm;
      }
    }
  }

  function interp(arr, t) {
    const idx = (t - T0_PRE) / PRE_DT;
    const i = Math.floor(idx);
    if (i < 0) return arr[0];
    if (i >= PRE_N - 1) return arr[PRE_N - 1];
    const f = idx - i;
    return arr[i] * (1 - f) + arr[i + 1] * f;
  }

  // ---- visual scale (set on resize) ----
  let W = 0, H = 0, R_MAX = 180, WAVE_C = 500;
  let WELL_G = 1e6, WELL_SOFT2 = 400, WELL_MAX = 40, WAVE_COEFF = 400;
  let SPAN = 600, SPACING = 40;

  function resize() {
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = window.innerWidth;
    H = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = W * dpr;
    canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    const S = Math.min(W, H);
    R_MAX = S * 0.255;
    WAVE_C = S * 0.58;
    const typR = 0.38 * R_MAX;
    WELL_G = 0.11 * R_MAX * typR * typR;
    WELL_SOFT2 = (0.125 * R_MAX) ** 2;
    WELL_MAX = 0.125 * R_MAX;
    WAVE_COEFF = 0.0036 * R_MAX * R_MAX;
    SPAN = Math.max(W, H) * 0.72 + R_MAX * 0.4;
    SPACING = Math.max(32, Math.round(S / 28));
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  function wells(x, y, t) {
    const frac = interp(preFrac, t);
    const phi = interp(prePhi, t);
    const r = frac * R_MAX;
    let dx = 0, dy = 0;
    if (r > 1.2) {
      const hx = 0.5 * r * Math.cos(phi);
      const hy = 0.5 * r * Math.sin(phi);
      for (const s of [1, -1]) {
        const rx = x - s * hx, ry = y - s * hy;
        const r2 = rx * rx + ry * ry + WELL_SOFT2;
        const inv = 1 / (r2 * Math.sqrt(r2));
        dx -= WELL_G * rx * inv;
        dy -= WELL_G * ry * inv;
      }
    } else {
      const r2 = x * x + y * y + WELL_SOFT2 * 1.35;
      const inv = 1 / (r2 * Math.sqrt(r2));
      dx -= WELL_G * 2.05 * x * inv;
      dy -= WELL_G * 2.05 * y * inv;
    }
    const mag = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (mag > WELL_MAX) {
      dx *= WELL_MAX / mag;
      dy *= WELL_MAX / mag;
    }
    return [dx, dy];
  }

  function warp(x, y, t) {
    const [wx, wy] = wells(x, y, t);
    const R = Math.hypot(x, y);
    const th = Math.atan2(y, x);
    const tRet = t - R / WAVE_C;
    const chirp = interp(preChirp, tRet);
    const wph = interp(preWPh, tRet);
    const safeR = Math.max(R, 0.12 * R_MAX);
    const phase = wph - 2 * th;          // m = 2 outgoing quadrupole
    const h = WAVE_COEFF * chirp / safeR;
    const c = Math.cos(phase);
    const s = Math.sin(phase);
    // transverse (φ) displacement + small second polarization
    const px = -y / safeR, py = x / safeR;
    const nx = x / safeR, ny = y / safeR;
    const dvx = h * (c * px + 0.55 * s * nx);
    const dvy = h * (c * py + 0.55 * s * ny);
    return [x + wx + dvx, y + wy + dvy];
  }

  function drawHoles(t) {
    const frac = interp(preFrac, t);
    const phi = interp(prePhi, t);
    const r = frac * R_MAX;
    const rad = 0.078 * R_MAX;
    const radR = 0.118 * R_MAX;

    const glow = (bx, by, radH, massScale) => {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(bx, by, radH * 0.55, bx, by, radH * 2.35);
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      g.addColorStop(0.42, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)');
      g.addColorStop(0.68, 'rgba(255,110,35,0.28)');
      g.addColorStop(0.80, 'rgba(255,190,70,0.75)');
      g.addColorStop(0.87, 'rgba(255,245,210,0.55)');
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,80,10,0)');
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, radH * 2.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, radH, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx, by, radH * 1.18, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,160,0.9)';
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, radH * 0.08);
      ctx.shadowColor = '#ffb040';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    };

    if (r > 3) {
      glow(0.5 * r * Math.cos(phi), 0.5 * r * Math.sin(phi), rad, 1);
      glow(-0.5 * r * Math.cos(phi), -0.5 * r * Math.sin(phi), rad, 1);
    } else {
      glow(0, 0, radR, 2);
    }
  }

  function drawLabels(t) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(190,210,240,0.38)';
    ctx.font = '600 13px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.letterSpacing = '0.18em';
    ctx.fillText('GRAVITATIONAL  WAVES', W / 2, 32);
    ctx.font = '400 11px system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif';
    ctx.letterSpacing = '0.12em';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,185,220,0.28)';
    ctx.fillText('BINARY BLACK HOLE COALESCENCE', W / 2, 50);

    let phase = 'inspiral';
    if (t >= T_MERGE + 0.15) phase = 'ringdown';
    else if (t >= T_MERGE - 0.45) phase = 'merger';
    ctx.font = '400 10px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(140,170,210,0.30)';
    ctx.letterSpacing = '0.28em';
    ctx.fillText(phase.toUpperCase(), W / 2, H - 22);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function render(t) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.75);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#0b1220');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#030308');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    // build warped polylines once
    const lines = [];
    const res = 7;
    for (let y = -SPAN; y <= SPAN; y += SPACING) {
      const pts = [];
      for (let x = -SPAN; x <= SPAN; x += res) pts.push(warp(x, y, t));
      lines.push(pts);
    }
    for (let x = -SPAN; x <= SPAN; x += SPACING) {
      const pts = [];
      for (let y = -SPAN; y <= SPAN; y += res) pts.push(warp(x, y, t));
      lines.push(pts);
    }

    const passes = [
      { lw: 5.5, a: 0.045, blur: 16, col: '70,150,255' },
      { lw: 1.15, a: 0.26, blur: 3.5, col: '150,215,255' }
    ];
    for (const p of passes) {
      ctx.lineWidth = p.lw;
      ctx.shadowBlur = p.blur;
      ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${p.col},0.85)`;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${p.col},${p.a})`;
      for (const pts of lines) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
        for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    drawHoles(t);
    ctx.restore();
    drawLabels(t);
  }

  let t0 = null;
  function frame(now) {
    if (t0 === null) t0 = now;
    const t = Math.min((now - t0) / 1000, DURATION);
    render(t);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Gravitational Wave Animation</title>
<style>
  body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
  canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const size = 600;
  canvas.width = size; canvas.height = size;
  
  const gridStep = 20;
  const gridColors = ['#111111', '#333333', '#555555', '#777777', '#999999', '#bbbbbb'];
  
  // Simulate wave height at (x,y,t) - simplified LIGO-like strain
  function strain(x, y, t) {
    const r = Math.sqrt(x*x + y*y);
    const theta = Math.atan2(y, x);
    
    // Ringdown-like damped oscillation (simplified)
    const timeFactor = Math.exp(-t / 0.3) * Math.sin(15 * t + theta);
    const wave = 0.05 * timeFactor * (1 + 0.3 * Math.cos(8 * t));
    
    // Peak near origin, symmetric
    return wave * Math.exp(-r * r / 80);
  }
  
  const frames = [];
  const duration = 30; // seconds
  const fps = 60;
  const totalFrames = Math.floor(duration * fps);
  
  for (let i = 0; i < totalFrames; i++) {
    const t = i / fps;
    const imgData = ctx.createImageData(size, size);
    const data = imgData.data;
    
    for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (let y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        // Normalize coordinates to [-1,1]
        const nx = (x - size/2) / (size/2);
        const ny = (y - size/2) / (size/2);
        
        // Compute strain at this frame
        const s = strain(nx, ny, t);
        
        // Map strain [-0.05,0.05] to [0,255] with dark grid
        const base = Math.floor(255 * (1 + s) / 2);
        const gridIdx = Math.floor((x % gridStep) / gridStep);
        const bgColor = gridColors[gridIdx % gridColors.length];
        
        // Set color: background grid + slight wave tint
        const idx = (y * size + x) * 4;
        data[idx] = bgColor[0];
        data[idx+1] = bgColor[1];
        data[idx+2] = bgColor[2];
        data[idx+3] = 255;
        
        // Add subtle wave brightness variation
        const waveBright = 255 * (1 + s * 2);
        data[idx] = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, bgColor[0] + (waveBright - 255) * 0.3));
        data[idx+1] = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, bgColor[1] + (waveBright - 255) * 0.3));
        data[idx+2] = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, bgColor[2] + (waveBright - 255) * 0.3));
      }
    }
    
    frames.push(imgData);
  }
  
  // Draw frames sequentially
  function animate(frameIdx) {
    ctx.putImageData(frames[frameIdx % frames.length], 0, 0);
    if (frameIdx < frames.length - 1) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => animate(frameIdx + 1));
    }
  }
  
  animate(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>

question: gravitational-waves-visualization
prompt: Generate a beautiful, 30-second soft grid animation in HTML visualizing gravitational waves from two colliding black holes including ringdown. Maximize physical accuracy and sanity check the trajectories. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Gravitational Wave Grid</title>
<style>
  html,body { margin:0; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#05060a; }
  canvas { display:block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W, H, cx, cy;
  const spacing = 20;
  let grid = [];

  function resize() {
    W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    cx = W/2; cy = H/2;
    buildGrid();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

  function buildGrid() {
    grid = [];
    const cols = Math.floor(W/spacing)+1;
    const rows = Math.floor(H/spacing)+1;
    for (let r=0; r<rows; r++) {
      for (let c=0; c<cols; c++) {
        grid.push({ ox: c*spacing, oy: r*spacing, x: c*spacing, y: r*spacing });
      }
    }
  }

  // --- Physics in geometric units (G=c=1, total mass M=1) ---
  // Equal masses: mu = M/4 = 0.25
  // da/dt = -64/5 * mu * M^2 / a^3 = -16/5 / a^3
  // a(t) = (a0^4 - 4*A*t)^(1/4), A = 16/5
  // GW phase Phi = 1/4 * (a0^(5/2) - a^(5/2))
  const a0 = 6.5;
  const a_merger = 3.0;
  const A = 16/5;
  const t_inspiral_geom = (Math.pow(a0,4) - Math.pow(a_merger,4)) / (4*A);
  const t_merger_anim = 24; // seconds
  const total_anim = 30;
  const M_sec = t_merger_anim / t_inspiral_geom; // geometric time unit in seconds
  const tau_sec = 11.24 * 0.95 * M_sec; // ringdown damping time
  const f_rd_sec = (0.06 / 0.95) / M_sec; // ringdown frequency in Hz
  const P = 30; // pixels per M
  const c_visual = P / M_sec; // speed of light in px/s (scaled)
  const Phi_merger = 0.25 * (Math.pow(a0,2.5) - Math.pow(a_merger,2.5));
  const phi_rd = Phi_merger % (2*Math.PI);

  function a_of_time(t_anim) {
    if (t_anim >= t_merger_anim) return a_merger;
    const t_geom = t_anim / M_sec;
    const val = Math.pow(a0,4) - 4*A*t_geom;
    return Math.pow(Math.max(val, 0), 0.25);
  }

  function Phi_of_time(t_anim) {
    if (t_anim >= t_merger_anim) return Phi_merger;
    const a = a_of_time(t_anim);
    return 0.25 * (Math.pow(a0,2.5) - Math.pow(a,2.5));
  }

  function sourceStrain(t) {
    if (t < 0 || t >= total_anim) return 0;
    if (t < t_merger_anim) {
      const a = a_of_time(t);
      const Phi = Phi_of_time(t);
      return (1/a) * Math.cos(Phi);
    } else {
      const t_rd = t - t_merger_anim;
      const A_rd = 1 / a_merger;
      return A_rd * Math.exp(-t_rd / tau_sec) * Math.cos(2*Math.PI*f_rd_sec*t_rd + phi_rd);
    }
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#05060a';
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,0,cx,cy,Math.max(W,H)*0.7);
    bg.addColorStop(0,'#0e1420');
    bg.addColorStop(1,'#05060a');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }

  function drawGrid(t_anim) {
    const cols = Math.floor(W/spacing)+1;
    const rows = Math.floor(H/spacing)+1;
    const pts = grid;

    for (let i=0; i<pts.length; i++) {
      const p = pts[i];
      const dx0 = p.ox - cx;
      const dy0 = p.oy - cy;
      const r = Math.sqrt(dx0*dx0 + dy0*dy0);
      if (r < 1) { p.x = p.ox; p.y = p.oy; continue; }

      const t_ret = t_anim - r / c_visual;
      const s = sourceStrain(t_ret);
      let h = s * P / r;
      if (h > 0.4) h = 0.4;
      if (h < -0.4) h = -0.4;

      // Visual plus-polarization displacement
      p.x = p.ox + h * dx0 * 0.5;
      p.y = p.oy - h * dy0 * 0.5;
    }

    // Soft glow pass
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,160,255,0.04)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let row=0; row<rows; row++) {
      for (let col=0; col<cols-1; col++) {
        const i = row*cols + col;
        ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
        ctx.lineTo(pts[i+1].x, pts[i+1].y);
      }
    }
    for (let col=0; col<cols; col++) {
      for (let row=0; row<rows-1; row++) {
        const i = row*cols + col;
        ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
        ctx.lineTo(pts[i+cols].x, pts[i+cols].y);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Crisp pass
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,200,255,0.22)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let row=0; row<rows; row++) {
      for (let col=0; col<cols-1; col++) {
        const i = row*cols + col;
        ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
        ctx.lineTo(pts[i+1].x, pts[i+1].y);
      }
    }
    for (let col=0; col<cols; col++) {
      for (let row=0; row<rows-1; row++) {
        const i = row*cols + col;
        ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
        ctx.lineTo(pts[i+cols].x, pts[i+cols].y);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawBH(x,y,r,alpha=1) {
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,r*0.2,x,y,r*2.5);
    glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(120,180,255,${0.35*alpha})`);
    glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,180,255,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,r*2.5,0,2*Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();

    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,r*0.1,x,y,r);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#000');
    grad.addColorStop(0.85, '#000');
    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,40,80,0.9)');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,2*Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(150,200,255,${0.5*alpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,2*Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawTrail(t_anim) {
    if (t_anim >= t_merger_anim) return;
    const steps = 120;
    for (let i=0; i<=steps; i++) {
      const tt = t_anim * i / steps;
      const a = a_of_time(tt);
      const phi = Phi_of_time(tt) / 2;
      const x = cx - (a/2)*P*Math.cos(phi);
      const y = cy - (a/2)*P*Math.sin(phi);
      const alpha = 0.04 + 0.18 * (i/steps);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(100,180,255,${alpha})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x,y,2,0,2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();

      const x2 = cx + (a/2)*P*Math.cos(phi);
      const y2 = cy + (a/2)*P*Math.sin(phi);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x2,y2,2,0,2*Math.PI);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawBlackHoles(t_anim) {
    if (t_anim < t_merger_anim) {
      const a = a_of_time(t_anim);
      const phi = Phi_of_time(t_anim) / 2;
      const x1 = cx - (a/2)*P*Math.cos(phi);
      const y1 = cy - (a/2)*P*Math.sin(phi);
      const x2 = cx + (a/2)*P*Math.cos(phi);
      const y2 = cy + (a/2)*P*Math.sin(phi);
      drawBH(x1,y1,P);
      drawBH(x2,y2,P);
    } else {
      // Remnant BH mass ~0.95 M -> radius ~1.9 M
      drawBH(cx,cy,1.9*P);
    }
  }

  function drawMergerFlash(t_anim) {
    if (t_anim < t_merger_anim || t_anim > t_merger_anim + 2) return;
    const t = t_anim - t_merger_anim;
    const r = t * c_visual;
    const alpha = Math.max(0, 0.5 * Math.exp(-t*2));
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(150,200,255,${alpha})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,2*Math.PI);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawHUD(t_anim) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,200,255,0.7)';
    ctx.font = '12px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(`t = ${t_anim.toFixed(1)}s`, 20, 30);
    if (t_anim < t_merger_anim) {
      const a = a_of_time(t_anim);
      const f = (1/(Math.PI*Math.pow(a,1.5))) / M_sec;
      ctx.fillText(`a = ${a.toFixed(2)} M`, 20, 50);
      ctx.fillText(`f_GW = ${f.toFixed(3)} Hz`, 20, 70);
    } else {
      const t_rd = t_anim - t_merger_anim;
      ctx.fillText(`ringdown`, 20, 50);
      ctx.fillText(`f_ring = ${f_rd_sec.toFixed(3)} Hz`, 20, 70);
      ctx.fillText(`t_rd = ${t_rd.toFixed(1)}s`, 20, 90);
    }
  }

  function draw(t_anim) {
    drawBackground();
    drawGrid(t_anim);
    drawTrail(t_anim);
    drawBlackHoles(t_anim);
    drawMergerFlash(t_anim);
    drawHUD(t_anim);
  }

  // Sanity check of the trajectory/waveform constants
  console.log('t_inspiral_geom =', t_inspiral_geom.toFixed(3));
  console.log('M_sec =', M_sec.toFixed(5), 's');
  console.log('f_merger =', ((1/(Math.PI*Math.pow(a_merger,1.5)))/M_sec).toFixed(3), 'Hz');
  console.log('f_ring =', f_rd_sec.toFixed(3), 'Hz');
  console.log('tau_ring =', tau_sec.toFixed(3), 's');

  let startTime = performance.now();
  function animate(now) {
    let t = (now - startTime) / 1000;
    if (t >= total_anim) {
      startTime = now;
      t = 0;
    }
    draw(t);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

                 a(tau)     = A_REF     * tau^(+1/4)     [radiation reaction]

                 f_GW       = 2 * f_orb                   [quadrupole]
     Waves    :  evaluated at retarded time  t - r/c
     Ringdown :  h(t) = h_m * exp(-(t-tc)/TAU_DAMP) * cos(omega_RD*(t-tc))
                 Q = omega_RD*TAU_DAMP/2 ≈ 3.3  (Kerr a≈0.7, l=m=2 QNM)
   ============================================================ */

const cv = document.getElementById('c'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');

// ---------------- physical parameters ----------------
const T_TOTAL  = 30;      // seconds (animation length)
const TC       = 22;      // coalescence time
const TAU_MIN  = 0.15;    // cutoff ~ ISCO, start of plunge
const OMEGA_REF= 2.5;     // orbital ang. freq (rad/s) at tau = 1 s
const A_REF    = 42;      // separation (px) at tau = 1 s
const C_WAVE   = 170;     // wave speed (px/s)
const AMP0     = 11;      // strain -> grid displacement scale (px)
const TAU_DAMP = 1.3;     // ringdown damping time  (Q ≈ 3.3)
const OMEGA_RD = OMEGA_REF * Math.pow(TAU_MIN, -3/8); // phase-continuous
const DT       = 1/240;
const N        = Math.ceil(T_TOTAL/DT) + 2;
const ENV_M    = Math.pow(TAU_MIN, -1/4);  // envelope at merger

// ---------------- precompute phase / envelope / strain ----------------
const phaseA = new Float32Array(N), envA = new Float32Array(N),
      omA    = new Float32Array(N), hA   = new Float32Array(N);
(function(){
  let phi = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++){
    const t = i*DT;
    let om, env;
    if (t <= TC){
      const tau = Math.max(TC - t, TAU_MIN);
      om  = OMEGA_REF * Math.pow(tau, -3/8);
      env = Math.pow(om / OMEGA_REF, 2/3);
    } else {
      om  = OMEGA_RD;
      env = ENV_M * Math.exp(-(t - TC)/TAU_DAMP);
    }
    omA[i] = om; envA[i] = env; phaseA[i] = phi;
    hA[i]  = env * Math.cos(2*phi);
    phi += om * DT;
  }
})();

function sample(t){
  if (t < 0){ const om = omA[0];
    return { phi: phaseA[0] + om*t, env: envA[0], om }; }
  if (t >= T_TOTAL) t = T_TOTAL - 1e-4;
  const f = t/DT, i = f|0, fr = f - i;
  return { phi: phaseA[i]   + (phaseA[i+1]-phaseA[i])*fr,
           env: envA[i]     + (envA[i+1]  -envA[i])*fr,
           om : omA[i]      + (omA[i+1]   -omA[i])*fr };
}

// separation of the two holes (px); linear plunge below TAU_MIN
function sep(t){
  if (t >= TC) return 0;
  const tau = TC - t;
  if (tau >= TAU_MIN) return A_REF * Math.pow(tau, 0.25);
  return A_REF * Math.pow(TAU_MIN, 0.25) * (tau / TAU_MIN);
}

// ---------------- canvas / grid setup ----------------
let W, H, CX, CY, gx = [], gy = [], PX, PY, MG, stars = [];
const SPACING = 34;

function resize(){
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  W = innerWidth; H = innerHeight;
  cv.width = W*dpr; cv.height = H*dpr;
  cv.style.width = W+'px'; cv.style.height = H+'px';
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  CX = W/2; CY = H/2;
  const nx = Math.ceil(W/SPACING)+2, ny = Math.ceil(H/SPACING)+2;
  const ox = (W-(nx-1)*SPACING)/2, oy = (H-(ny-1)*SPACING)/2;
  gx = []; gy = [];
  for (let i=0;i<nx;i++) gx.push(ox+i*SPACING);
  for (let j=0;j<ny;j++) gy.push(oy+j*SPACING);
  PX = new Float32Array(nx*ny); PY = new Float32Array(nx*ny);
  MG = new Float32Array(nx*ny);
  stars = [];
  for (let i=0;i<140;i++) stars.push({
    x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*H,
    r: Math.random()*1.2+0.3, a: Math.random()*0.5+0.15 });
}
addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();

// ---------------- color buckets for fast batched strokes ----------------
const NB = 26, buckets = Array.from({length:NB}, () => []);
const colStr = [];
for (let b=0;b<NB;b++){
  const v = b/(NB-1);
  colStr[b] = `hsla(${215-28*v},${55+35*v}%,${15+60*v}%,${0.22+0.68*v})`;
}

// ---------------- drawing helpers ----------------
function drawBH(x, y, r, squash){
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x,y);
  ctx.scale(1+(squash||0), 1-(squash||0));
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,r*0.4, 0,0,r*2.4);
  g.addColorStop(0.00,'#000');
  g.addColorStop(0.42,'#000');
  g.addColorStop(0.50,'rgba(255,196,130,0.95)'); // photon-ring glow
  g.addColorStop(0.62,'rgba(255,120,60,0.22)');
  g.addColorStop(1.00,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,r*2.4,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawScope(t){
  const w = Math.min(560, W*0.72), h = 64;
  const x0 = (W-w)/2, y0 = H - h - 24;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,24,0.55)';
  ctx.fillRect(x0, y0, w, h);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,150,200,0.25)';
  ctx.strokeRect(x0+0.5, y0+0.5, w-1, h-1);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x0, y0+h/2); ctx.lineTo(x0+w, y0+h/2);
  ctx.stroke();
  // waveform over the last 8 s
  const TW = 8, n = 260;
  ctx.beginPath();
  for (let k=0;k<=n;k++){
    const tt = t - TW + (k/n)*TW;
    let hv = 0;
    if (tt >= 0){ const i = Math.min(N-1, Math.round(tt/DT)); hv = hA[i]; }
    const X = x0 + 6 + (w-12)*k/n;
    const Y = y0 + h/2 - (hv/ENV_M)*(h/2 - 8);
    k ? ctx.lineTo(X,Y) : ctx.moveTo(X,Y);
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140,200,255,0.9)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; ctx.stroke(); ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  if (t - TW < TC && TC < t){          // merger marker
    const X = x0 + 6 + (w-12)*((TC-(t-TW))/TW);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,180,120,0.6)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X,y0+4); ctx.lineTo(X,y0+h-4); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,190,230,0.7)';
  ctx.font = '11px ui-monospace, monospace';
  ctx.fillText('strain h(t) at a fixed observer', x0+8, y0+14);
}

// ---------------- main loop ----------------
const t0 = performance.now();
function frame(now){
  const t = ((now - t0)/1000) % T_TOTAL;
  const s = sample(t);

  // background + vignette + stars
  ctx.fillStyle = '#030309'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX,CY,0, CX,CY, Math.max(W,H)*0.7);
  vg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(20,26,55,0.35)');
  vg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)');
  ctx.fillStyle = vg; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  for (const st of stars){
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200,215,255,${st.a})`;
    ctx.fillRect(st.x, st.y, st.r, st.r);
  }

  // ---- displace grid vertices (retarded-time quadrupole pattern) ----
  const nx = gx.length, ny = gy.length;
  for (let j=0;j<ny;j++){
    const yb = gy[j] - CY;
    for (let i=0;i<nx;i++){
      const xb = gx[i] - CX;
      const r  = Math.hypot(xb, yb);
      const sr = sample(t - r/C_WAVE);
      const A  = AMP0 * sr.env * (90/(r+90));       // ~1/r falloff, softened
      const a2 = 2*Math.atan2(yb,xb) - 2*sr.phi;    // quadrupole, m=2
      const ur = A*Math.cos(a2), ut = 0.5*A*Math.sin(a2);
      const inv = r > 1e-6 ? 1/r : 0;
      const cx = xb*inv, sy = yb*inv;
      const k = j*nx + i;
      PX[k] = gx[i] + ur*cx - ut*sy;
      PY[k] = gy[j] + ur*sy + ut*cx;
      MG[k] = A;
    }
  }

  // ---- batch segments by intensity ----
  for (let b=0;b<NB;b++) buckets[b].length = 0;
  for (let j=0;j<ny;j++) for (let i=0;i<nx-1;i++){
    const k=j*nx+i;
    let b = ((MG[k]+MG[k+1])*0.9)|0; if (b>=NB) b=NB-1;
    const B=buckets[b]; B.push(PX[k],PY[k],PX[k+1],PY[k+1]);
  }
  for (let i=0;i<nx;i++) for (let j=0;j<ny-1;j++){
    const k=j*nx+i, k2=k+nx;
    let b = ((MG[k]+MG[k2])*0.9)|0; if (b>=NB) b=NB-1;
    const B=buckets[b]; B.push(PX[k],PY[k],PX[k2],PY[k2]);
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let b=0;b<NB;b++){
    const B = buckets[b]; if (!B.length) continue;
    ctx.strokeStyle = colStr[b];
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let q=0;q<B.length;q+=4){ ctx.moveTo(B[q],B[q+1]); ctx.lineTo(B[q+2],B[q+3]); }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

  // ---- black holes ----
  const a = sep(t);
  if (a > 0){
    const d = a/2, ph = s.phi;
    drawBH(CX + d*Math.cos(ph), CY + d*Math.sin(ph), 11, 0);
    drawBH(CX - d*Math.cos(ph), CY - d*Math.sin(ph), 11, 0);
  } else {
    const tr = t - TC;
    const q  = Math.exp(-tr/TAU_DAMP) * Math.cos(OMEGA_RD*tr); // QNM
    const R  = 13 + 4*(1 - Math.exp(-tr/0.4));
    drawBH(CX, CY, R, 0.12*q);                    // quadrupolar ringdown shape
    const fl = Math.exp(-Math.pow((t-TC)/0.25, 2)); // merger flash
    if (fl > 0.01){
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(CX,CY,0, CX,CY,130);
      g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,230,190,${0.8*fl})`);
      g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(CX,CY,130,0,6.2832); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // ---- HUD ----
  const phaseName = t < TC-0.5 ? 'INSPIRAL' : (t < TC+0.5 ? 'MERGER' : 'RINGDOWN');
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,220,255,0.9)';
  ctx.font = '600 15px system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('Binary Black Hole Merger — Gravitational Waves', 20, 30);
  ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,180,220,0.8)';
  ctx.fillText('quadrupole radiation · retarded-time propagation · QNM ringdown', 20, 48);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,200,140,0.95)';
  ctx.font = '600 14px ui-monospace, monospace';
  ctx.fillText(phaseName, W-20, 30);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(150,180,220,0.8)';
  ctx.font = '12px ui-monospace, monospace';
  ctx.fillText(`f_GW = ${(s.om/Math.PI).toFixed(2)} Hz   t_c − t = ${(TC-t).toFixed(1)} s`, W-20, 48);
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';

  drawScope(t);

  // ---- fade at loop boundaries ----
  let fade = 1;
  if (t < 0.7) fade = t/0.7;
  else if (t > T_TOTAL-0.7) fade = (T_TOTAL-t)/0.7;
  if (fade < 1){
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(3,3,9,${1-fade})`;
    ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Gravitational Wave Animation</title>
  <style>
    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: black;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      height: 100vh;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="gravitationalCanvas"></canvas>
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gravitationalCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  // Set canvas size
  canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

  const width = canvas.width;
  const height = canvas.height;

  const gridSize = 20; // Grid size in pixels
  const centerX = width / 2;
  const centerY = height / 2;

  const maxWaveAmplitude = gridSize * 2; // Max wave amplitude
  const collisionFrequency = 0.02; // Frequency of wave oscillations
  const ringdownDecay = 0.98; // Exponential decay for ringdown
  const totalDuration = 30 * 1000; // 30 seconds in milliseconds
  const startTime = Date.now();

  function draw() {
    const currentTime = Date.now();
    const elapsedTime = currentTime - startTime;

    if (elapsedTime > totalDuration) {
      return; // Stop animation after 30 seconds
    }

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    const time = elapsedTime / 1000; // Time in seconds
    const waveAmplitude = maxWaveAmplitude * Math.exp(-time * ringdownDecay); // Exponential decay
    const frequency = collisionFrequency * (1 + time * 0.1); // Frequency increases over time

    for (let x = 0; x <= width; x += gridSize) {
      for (let y = 0; y <= height; y += gridSize) {
        const dx = x - centerX;
        const dy = y - centerY;
        const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);

        // Calculate wave effect
        const wave = waveAmplitude * Math.sin(frequency * distance - time * 2 * Math.PI);

        // Distort grid points
        const offsetX = wave * Math.cos(angle);
        const offsetY = wave * Math.sin(angle);

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x + offsetX, y + offsetY, 2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(173, 216, 230, 0.8)'; // Light blue color
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  draw();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Gravitational Waves Visualization</title>
<style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas></canvas>
<script>
    const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

    let width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    let height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    let centerX = width / 2;
    let centerY = height / 2;
    let maxRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.4;
    let numRings = 30;
    let maxWaves = 3;

    function draw() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
        let time = Date.now() / 1000;
        let waveSpread = 50;  // Spread of waves from the center

        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        
        for (let i = 0; i < numRings; i++) {
            let radius = (i / numRings) * maxRadius;
            let offset = Math.sin(time * Math.PI * 2 + i) * waveSpread;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${1 - i / numRings})`;
            ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius + offset, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.stroke();
        }
    }

    function resize() {
        width = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        height = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        centerX = width / 2;
        centerY = height / 2;
        maxRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.4;
    }

    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    setInterval(draw, 1000 / 60);  // 60 fps
</script>
</body>
